dialogue.line: I... do appreciate you speaking to me. Now please – leave me alone.

dialogue.line: Listen, I – God, how do I even...

dialogue.speaker: 00855031422B04E4A0A721B724D372E2
dialogue.line: Marat... he died because of me.

dialogue.speaker: 091CC196473236E8417796AB9C9049F9
dialogue.line: Nothing, sorry I bothered you.

dialogue.speaker: 1794EA6B4EC99C0D5120E78B393DF3B2
dialogue.line: Nothing, sorry I bothered you.

dialogue.speaker: 2F5D0AC7413E4E945B00B1BE35D72E05
dialogue.line: Now... Leave me be. Please.

dialogue.speaker: 30E42DDC46A45CCA9083F08C44E1F263
dialogue.line: Oh, it's you. Yes? Want to buy something?

dialogue.speaker: 23CB248348687E11058E97A1FF1EBF54
dialogue.line: Please, forgive me.

dialogue.speaker: DE58C312479B851B3E39C3B475A3AA44
dialogue.line: Please, forgive me.

dialogue.speaker: 1306CEBC45A451D8A9B0D28DACCDAE3C
dialogue.line: Right... Well, just thought you should know, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: 253ADBD84F804E9D0E38D9A67134D23E
dialogue.line: Stubborn. Always thinking he knew best.

dialogue.speaker: AFC449114C81D23C1DC4C383CF1D215F
dialogue.line: Sure. But I think people here might need it more.

dialogue.speaker: EF79BD0142B7A32627357EA8C2C50CB9
dialogue.line: That there was plenty you didn't see eye-to-eye about. But even so he wanted to make you proud.

dialogue.speaker: EAA0C6F34518F782A4861B9F88C84B88
dialogue.line: They'll get what they need and I'm sure to make a bit of profit. Everybody wins.

dialogue.speaker: 10646E8E4523C2A55D956CA0F3470EFF
dialogue.line: Thought you should know, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: 729BA5654CD4D0485AE40C80751A46FD
dialogue.line: To sell my goods.

dialogue.speaker: 7A5D4F8D4D5108C9BAD79B91A251C233
dialogue.line: Um, no. I don't think so.

dialogue.speaker: 62ABB5F94450B024525D2DB3DBFCC5BF
dialogue.line: Well, if he really meant it he knew exactly what he needed to do.

dialogue.speaker: 991793F045FE9E7539CDB3A89A3E4930
dialogue.line: What do you want then?

dialogue.speaker: BD538F934C860A6ACD660EA56B860639
dialogue.line: What do you want to say, lad? Out with it.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male02
dialogue.line: What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: AC5934D443EDA1E6DD7221BB67B259E0
dialogue.line: Why come to Laslea?

dialogue.speaker: ECA491F4480FA973E136529A8F29B30B
dialogue.line: Why come to Laslea?

dialogue.speaker: 1BE9691A41072CDE64C560B3ABBF7FC9
dialogue.line: With pleasure.

dialogue.speaker: 61E253284B1FDDE292A1E182BA4BD140
dialogue.line: Yeah, I get that. What I meant is – why here specifically? You could go to Svartrau.

dialogue.speaker: E751E3734596965A26AD08BA80C91F2A
dialogue.line: Yes, my son. Don't presume that you know anything about our family.

dialogue.speaker: C3FFD0154F1E6D302080E2B7D7C29A3A
dialogue.line: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 4B45FD644006BBE055FACBB18E409DA7
dialogue.line: You say Marat failed you... but you've got it the other way round. You didn't deserve him.

dialogue.speaker: 6C4B52C942105794DC8644AEDEE0C4BF
dialogue.line: You should know that Marat died a true hero. Fighting for all of Vale Sangora.

dialogue.speaker: C7EF974F4A0B9269DC6941A4D25295D0
dialogue.line: You're a sad man, Ascar.

dialogue.speaker: 82F7D94C426B14CE8FC323B833D27F52
dialogue.line: You're a sad man.

dialogue.speaker: 61A74F0448F926CAE74ABFA642193258
dialogue.line: You're the one who sold out the manumits to the Knyaz.

dialogue.speaker: 20615E19463379BB928C0B93400D3578
dialogue.line: You've said your piece. Now leave me alone.

dialogue.speaker: 6529662A4B2B9BB9D603109681CC532F
dialogue.line: A bit of coughing... and I get these headaches. As if I'd been drinking heavily the night [coughs] the night before.

dialogue.speaker: D8C838714814B0F987C664BDB587C4B8
dialogue.line: Ah, I don't have the time for the likes of you. Your knyaz killed Zdislav and the village needs a new elderman.

dialogue.speaker: 241023A5414348F9AB4BCBAEE79D2DEF
dialogue.line: Alright! [cough] Jesus, that was a bad one. Right, see you around, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 92C1BC194EF12390497E8689D2E0ECE6
dialogue.line: And a fat lot of good it did. With Lunka -

dialogue.speaker: A6604E8D4FBCF2D8521105B72C5C283E
dialogue.line: And you want to fill those shoes?

dialogue.speaker: 39CCD43B483339F81A1F808148FD847C
dialogue.line: Anyway, Svartrau... no, the whole valley is better off without the vrakhiri.

dialogue.speaker: 6BA05AED41F902BD9D293DA3214D306E
dialogue.line: Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: C6F448E240392D15CA7435AAAE0EB4A4
dialogue.line: Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: 20E87A7E4D57D76FECDDDE892CC67745
dialogue.line: Are you alright?

dialogue.speaker: 985ACAFC4FAB3D67FB59A596A46A8902
dialogue.line: Are you alright?

dialogue.speaker: 3FE23137479158E7AECB22978104FCC7
dialogue.line: But lets [coughs] forget the politics for now.

dialogue.speaker: 9D1008684F23360C2660B4BEFCD9EEA1
dialogue.line: Coen! Yeah, Crake – sorry, Marat – said that he wanted to see Laslea, help [cough] help out with the rebuilding.

dialogue.speaker: 1CB2F02B487FC90257491380963EB373
dialogue.line: Coen! Yeah, I decided to return home, finally. With Crake dead... well, there wasn't much for me to do amongst the Manumits.

dialogue.speaker: 1FC9C4C94217811B92E60687C174812D
dialogue.line: Coen! Yeah, I stayed in Svartrau for a while, but it was high time to return home, you know?

dialogue.speaker: 244DD4F24D1538F9EB0F14A3899A14D3
dialogue.line: Coen, I'm... I'm sorry about Lunka. Iorgu told me.

dialogue.speaker: 8E47561642A8853B196BA79D7EB543D9
dialogue.line: Decided to keep him company. Good opportunity to see home again, right?

dialogue.speaker: F68BB7D5424F50B620E0F79C017C23E4
dialogue.line: Good luck, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: 39583A2A4F26A704DF50BFA0D802D456
dialogue.line: Hmgh. Yeah, not the little one's fault that her brother turned out to be a traitorous bastard.

dialogue.speaker: 4122D86E43DC9A43DD1E1EBF924F7DAC
dialogue.line: How are things in Svartrau?

dialogue.speaker: E8E9B0D644794D3F2B60FAA6C91F8CD8
dialogue.line: How are things in Svartrau?

dialogue.speaker: 9FB0A67549DBFB075AF7238E4D2FFDE0
dialogue.line: I am! In fact, I want to [cough] do much more.

dialogue.speaker: 241853C1415619492A37A6AE3D75EA93
dialogue.line: I don't want to talk about it.

dialogue.speaker: BEF8B5444E5E0B8DE5A031A2AD4EF238
dialogue.line: I don't want to talk about it.

dialogue.speaker: 19C2F27E4E0945EEA065E29B77DD2EBB
dialogue.line: I haven't met anyone more passionate about the valley – more determined to bring about a better tomorrow for its people.

dialogue.speaker: 63CE65FF417EC5112BE5E3A0A4B7872C
dialogue.line: I thinks that's a good idea.

dialogue.speaker: BC8FBE114BE19F1BE9911C852645F176
dialogue.line: I understand. Just remember that you have a friend who's a good listener, alright?

dialogue.speaker: 83EF530748FC7ACE416916B0F9E5A523
dialogue.line: I was wondering when you'd show up.

dialogue.speaker: 76888C574F69DF7539898BA6225EA55E
dialogue.line: I'm glad you think so. I know that [cough] I've made mistakes, even some grave ones... But I've learned from them.

dialogue.speaker: E3BF33E14C3DA0B76DBEAA9EB367BA61
dialogue.line: I'm warning you, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: AE9E6BFE410C593265E1C3A19F2C8E99
dialogue.line: I'm your friend, Coen. You know you can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: 4DDF6F92484AC399AAFE3FB9C0B5598D
dialogue.line: If not for you and your little rebellion, none of this would've happened!

dialogue.speaker: 2870DF8B4D6546D812818DB2E33CF621
dialogue.line: It's fine. I've been [cough] feeling a bit under the weather lately, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: 2255795047D514FD2EE3FCAA223007F7
dialogue.line: Listen, I have to talk to a few people. But I'll see you later on, alright?

dialogue.speaker: 91E1B69E474619996E2E3E866D28F7AD
dialogue.line: Maybe we should find someone to take a look at you?

dialogue.speaker: B03089AC416DE412B25393AD6E5653DF
dialogue.line: More importantly [cough] I wanted to see my friend again! The Hero of Vale Sangora!

dialogue.speaker: 9824A17A472912805090EBA6C5B2552E
dialogue.line: No, it's alright. I appreciate it, Coen, but you're fussing over nothing.

dialogue.speaker: C10D08764E2292F5E3B7FAB964BE8DCD
dialogue.line: Now, fuck off!

dialogue.speaker: FCE60358458FFDA6A88076A9EB5CDFD5
dialogue.line: Oh, right. Your family. I hope the lives of a few good people weren't too steep a price, eh?

dialogue.speaker: CC851EDF4C4C6C9DCEDC028A264A02CE
dialogue.line: Oh, the city is as busy as ever. With Brencis dead, things are finally changing. People have hope again!

dialogue.speaker: 78CB8B524D20E070B505D18E63CC351E
dialogue.line: Or maybe you'd do it yourself...

dialogue.speaker: 2957245D4D3CE10B930CBDBC109A85EC
dialogue.line: Or what? You're going to snitch on me too? Have your vrakhiri friends drain me?

dialogue.speaker: 8171738648E09A459A648EBCE7FD77E7
dialogue.line: Really? Because I heard that Knyaz Catalin has already ordered a few summary executions...

dialogue.speaker: 9A8EC1404ED1FAAA69319DAD480CCDB7
dialogue.line: Save your empty threats.

dialogue.speaker: 27DFE0754B1B7F4AB68C468A9D9C8003
dialogue.line: So you're staying here?

dialogue.speaker: 94D5FA374705D0781FEDE991BE5EE36F
dialogue.line: So you're staying here?

dialogue.speaker: BC3E9D864CBCB0132CDE8CA565FAB0A5
dialogue.line: Sure, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: 00D9DA6D435C69A1332D8090452DBF44
dialogue.line: Thank you. But I think it's almost a done deal – I don't see many people [cough] rushing to take this responsibility on themselves.

dialogue.speaker: 6204903E41CD7E0A2D8A8C854FA5A67A
dialogue.line: That's a good idea.

dialogue.speaker: D3D0925441756F41D974EB94AB5776FD
dialogue.line: That's good to hear. From the scraps of news we get here, it sounded like... well, like chaos on the streets.

dialogue.speaker: 500AEEFE4C51A7E36CAA719C9F694B84
dialogue.line: The only reason my knife is not between your ribs is because we were once friends.

dialogue.speaker: 83FFD1D44A9D9FD6C941698FC084178E
dialogue.line: Um, it is a trifle that way, yeah. Power vacuum and all that. But I'm... sure it will work itself out.

dialogue.speaker: 65B962AB47C999723339FE9D1EB93C89
dialogue.line: Vlad, I had no choice.

dialogue.speaker: 5C0D8BE84B7905608C1126BADFDCF433
dialogue.line: Vlad, I had no choice. Brencis was about to kill my family –

dialogue.speaker: C1298766426E1F9D17955A958DBD1742
dialogue.line: Vlad, listen –

dialogue.speaker: C56107554ABAC264DEF92E8E209FBF0A
dialogue.line: Vlad, save your empty threats.

dialogue.speaker: 0F3047B342019F89A6903F8F9D6A50C2
dialogue.line: Vlad... I'm sorry, but you'd be a terrible elderman. I've yet to meet anyone as hot-headed and irresponsible as you.

dialogue.speaker: B3E556BF43A8577078969697971A1DEE
dialogue.line: We were on the brink of winning this, Coen! Crake –

dialogue.speaker: B0857A3945E5858FF99F8F87BDCB5087
dialogue.line: Well, I can only wish you good luck, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: F8BFDD8A4644D98ACCFCE3BE88560497
dialogue.line: Well, if I'm elected, I'll have [cough] plenty of opportunities to prove you wrong.

dialogue.speaker: 1B4D45D246AE16E27D6596BCCF6E2C1C
dialogue.line: Well, yeah. It's been a bit bloody so far... but he has to reinforce his rule, right? And punish those who willingly served Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male02
dialogue.line: What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: AA02E7004DD13E5A5545378ACB5AEFC4
dialogue.line: Who knows, maybe I'll replace him. And then I'll make sure there's no place for you in Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: 3567C37346BF6CE500E0458F39D7916C
dialogue.line: With Zdislav killed by the vrakhiri – may he rest in peace – the village needs a new elderman.

dialogue.speaker: 761002454D7DF98C9BC90DA2CE0D165D
dialogue.line: Yes! I want to take care of Laslea. Properly.

dialogue.speaker: B5AFAFFE4C17B71737474EB590D6830D
dialogue.line: You know I'd never –

dialogue.speaker: ED49C0DE433BE125368E60B1800B6356
dialogue.line: You really think that, don't you?

dialogue.speaker: 7A4E125B4FE726A1C94BCCB90E97405F
dialogue.line: You sold us to Brencis. Crake and many good men and women died because of you.

dialogue.speaker: 5D3EC0B74C6AAF4521FE61A1D291710F
dialogue.line: You'd be a terrible elderman.

dialogue.speaker: 6828E7B24D82894FB5E32492329A0C93
dialogue.line: You're the reason it all happened!

vt_e: Do you even know how to fight?
In my homeland - we don't do this.

The job's dirty, but the pay's hefty.
There's a prize for your head!

You're dead, son of a whore!

dialogue.speaker: E1174210463CAEFF783DDB890B4900BE
dialogue.line: Let me, butterfingers.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: E19B2B774843C3609E28C098636B84E8
dialogue.line: Sara!!!

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: Shit.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: Oh, damn.

dialogue.speaker: 25620376459AD783642B169800A23BB8
dialogue.line: Oh, shit!

dialogue.speaker: 2DEC2C2B4FF822F746AAA78353A7563C
dialogue.line: ...should be the place.

dialogue.speaker: 2D606C19403FAF2E8AB9AFBABC99EE9A
dialogue.line: A light patch where the tapestry used to hang... We’re in the right place!

dialogue.speaker: D6EA2E6242C143FC62446E83F6E9F51B
dialogue.line: A light patch where the tapestry used to hang... We’re in the right place!

dialogue.speaker: 605638554695A150404D69A8E55496B6
dialogue.line: All right, this is the street. Let’s split up and ask folks if they know anything.

dialogue.speaker: DDA869E74B5885BA9A4644B3A6219C4C
dialogue.line: And this part of the floor is different. Look!

dialogue.speaker: C1DF764A47BD3694D319AB991EFBE02E
dialogue.line: Can you help me move it?

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: Come on.

dialogue.speaker: 295A26DA4C2328F68F4E77A8265FF873
dialogue.line: Doesn't seem like it.

dialogue.speaker: DF4901CB4E2CAA1C8E4E299942374E6A
dialogue.line: Good. High time we found it already.

dialogue.speaker: 45E285C943DF162E28873684F4F96035
dialogue.line: Hello! Anybody here?!

dialogue.speaker: 51A05DE04B86EF417A471D888F93FCA9
dialogue.line: Here. The archway.

dialogue.speaker: C96F81C24F6A12C9CB0C3E8C0F31C827
dialogue.line: Hey! Anyone here?

dialogue.speaker: C1EA8FDD4EE5D1FAD60632A99D811229
dialogue.line: Hey! What’s the holdup?

dialogue.speaker: 695CF3B542EB385C01580A86C6E623AA
dialogue.line: I could bust it open, but that’d make a racket...

dialogue.speaker: 7A0BBEE1475A33A6B49028B6FA5FB37B
dialogue.line: I've got nothing. And you?

dialogue.speaker: 923D792F4879618351CE7D93E1C4A740
dialogue.line: It's nothing. Had it since I worked in the mines.

dialogue.speaker: 42B1A93D470501CBD6DF879541CE1C81
dialogue.line: It's the yellow house! Come on.

dialogue.speaker: 33B5EB1A4840D9588AA4AFB9E4C35DF2
dialogue.line: Jesus, think about the experiments he carried out here.

dialogue.speaker: BEAFBEA74EDB20E1475716BFA23CF2F0
dialogue.line: Let's take a peek before the owner comes back.

dialogue.speaker: 45C63469453A9B17E0BB89B852B03405
dialogue.line: No books on the shelf... but I can feel draught behind it.

dialogue.speaker: 47D0275C4F03334F5855A9B81D3B581C
dialogue.line: No one's been here for ages.

dialogue.speaker: F914A11341D37A93C85903BA33E0FFD1
dialogue.line: No, better not. Give me a moment.

dialogue.speaker: 700F5E8D43B7B5EFC08896B26D5A9632
dialogue.line: Oh! That simple? Well then, We'll have it found in no time.

dialogue.speaker: 52A5B2DF42F9E4F2FF74DA882366D066
dialogue.line: Oh, I talked to that old lady for a bit...

dialogue.speaker: A14D40074EA4F5FB86E034B1D7BCCA04
dialogue.line: Silas’ workshop is down the street, to the left of the archway.

dialogue.speaker: F7885C554035A44AF6CE12B9DA2144C1
dialogue.line: So to the left of it...

dialogue.speaker: 86C25B1F437F52A1477352B5D383901C
dialogue.line: Some old bottles, and alchemical apparatuses... but no books.

dialogue.speaker: BA43DED744CA0EF13987679EF1692FC1
dialogue.line: Tell me she at least knew something about Silas...

dialogue.speaker: 993558534B2389A14669FEB912B5579E
dialogue.line: The chimney seems to go beneath the floor. Odd.

dialogue.speaker: 61871C6E48C6B4A4524E59ADA3958C1B
dialogue.line: The place looks perfectly ordinary... except for the chimney.

dialogue.speaker: 7F4EE3904D81D1E1DB0382B87212F06C
dialogue.line: There's a trapdoor under the floorboards.

dialogue.speaker: 6C9F59DD4868D90E67DB818658D20BD7
dialogue.line: This is the street. Let's look for the sign.

dialogue.speaker: 9914E41B4536A0FC7BFA77B1E6CE190A
dialogue.line: Ugh, yeah. Makes your skin crawl.

dialogue.speaker: 0AAD83424D8E8A8C669D2E9BF77FC71D
dialogue.line: Yeah. His place was down the street, to the left of the archway.

dialogue.speaker: 955039D541945BFFE9117EA62D690C9B
dialogue.line: You all right?

dialogue.speaker: FC5A39F4497EB8AAECDFE69ACEA2C984
dialogue.line: [cough]

dialogue.speaker: 1426180B401C98DB188DFBB9AD8AE306
dialogue.line: A rather distinctive tapestry.

dialogue.speaker: 2743AB124554DBAE9D947180579B8F9E
dialogue.line: According to legend, Silas stole corpses from a nearby cemetery. He could've dug it up in the process.

dialogue.speaker: 3FC6C5E14E8A8C8124C6679FF0989A1A
dialogue.line: Didn't you say Silas was a doctor?

dialogue.speaker: 2E1C69094A9FFBFC8F9D7EBF9239917D
dialogue.line: Guess that's all.

dialogue.speaker: AB87BBBF4194542AF3766CB6FE71C42B
dialogue.line: I don't know... Looks like he paid attention to details.

dialogue.speaker: 8DDC72184432D3AFB0FB98BC5B5EB40A
dialogue.line: I’d say it’s more likely an ancient funerary mask.

dialogue.speaker: F1F76C5C455D341DF26C6CB8CE6F0FDB
dialogue.line: Might very well be the artist’s imagination.

dialogue.speaker: 2698A47440CAD3A1592EF4938E51341C
dialogue.line: Most books pertaining to Silas have been banned, burned... So all I have is this – a woodcut showing his workshop.

dialogue.speaker: 8DBF28A740D07D09173A05A2B2B0BCFE
dialogue.line: Perhaps, posing as a cobbler.

dialogue.speaker: 8580EFFF4DA18ED78C72FF924D064F61
dialogue.line: So this is Silas... Doesn't really look like a deranged lunatic.

dialogue.speaker: 085CFA7A4EE3CA7F61965FB53B492F49
dialogue.line: Still not sure what I'm looking at...

dialogue.speaker: 623C5D3F43D9726B5D02EB907A19FCAC
dialogue.line: That's an odd sculpture.

dialogue.speaker: 4A3530F947B603E063D0C1B7EB516E56
dialogue.line: Ugh, charming.

dialogue.speaker: 4D62832D4EAC1CC556717495DC934FE9
dialogue.line: Wait, there's a cobbler's sign over the door.

dialogue.speaker: 1A69F16C49297CA8EB98F3918ED2AD71
dialogue.line: Well, they rarely do.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: What...?

dialogue.speaker: E93D381B478368A617A406855489281F
dialogue.line: Yes. But once his twisted experiments began, he went into hiding.

dialogue.speaker: 012B283B41DD8B25159AEAA2F9C7C6AB
dialogue.line: [sigh] Probably stolen or burned by now.

dialogue.speaker: 603B2A3B463B0A92CAA562B994D803D5
dialogue.line: A bit of cold doesn't excuse being an arsehole. Though maybe... there's more to it than that.

dialogue.speaker: 91DA7ADD4A5F4DB11BEDF69E4BF8FDE6
dialogue.line: A bloody loud-mouthed prick... Even now, he wasn’t exactly an easy victory.

dialogue.speaker: B8532C0F4B91A8A97D7D3FAB28EFD3F7
dialogue.line: A bloody mess. Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 73A94F84400FB86EF880F881229F5D92
dialogue.line: According to my spies, the castle guard fell into complete disarray after his death.

dialogue.speaker: 4CD641C247B8B0433537ABADCA9CDFCA
dialogue.line: And the boyars are done for, since you've already killed Xanthe.

dialogue.speaker: 3E9B6D6446CFBEF62D574F8DDFE6F09A
dialogue.line: Argh! Fucking abomination!

dialogue.speaker: 30CE23CD4B674E22C6DB0DA534306B3E
dialogue.line: At least Xanthe shouldn't stand in our way.

dialogue.speaker: 5ECBAF9C4FEF4A645D6C9B8647EBF1C0
dialogue.line: Aye, no warmth here. No comfort, just shadows and stone. No wonder Catalin turned out the way he did...

dialogue.speaker: EEB0D6E04ED887D88EBDB8AB7FD387F2
dialogue.line: Aye. Brencis will pay dearly for what he's done.

dialogue.speaker: DA928C764CEBF35E11B055A2D6297E37
dialogue.line: Blood slaves...

dialogue.speaker: 37A47DCF403D072FD9867A9FE2331ACB
dialogue.line: Bloody hell! How is it moving so fast?!

dialogue.speaker: BFC8794B4FA760AED435A1BD7E7E4157
dialogue.line: Bloody old hag... She looked half-turned to dust, but still put up one hell of a fight.

dialogue.speaker: 51E17AA84A4E6A9BF49D7E9D6F807151
dialogue.line: Brencis needs to suffer.

dialogue.speaker: 93E980FC4B6A952A398E1AB2020C136B
dialogue.line: Brencis... He won’t stop… unless you stop him.

dialogue.speaker: 90D782E948DA9405404634AC27A63DEC
dialogue.line: Coen, stop stalling. Brencis is still out there, slaughtering my men!

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: Come on.

dialogue.speaker: 2D3DEAC4413C3CF82713EAB972758ECB
dialogue.line: Did they seem weaker than usual?

dialogue.speaker: 25B2CE364E278BAFFCDD1CBC079878BA
dialogue.line: Don’t forget about Xanthe. She might be nearby, or by Brencis’s side.

dialogue.speaker: 6BBA1C244EA6B1425C7A33821B582875
dialogue.line: Enough! Brencis is still out there, slaughtering my men!

dialogue.speaker: 9A6294B24198968849D9FDA16F421FA2
dialogue.line: Finally!

dialogue.speaker: E82F6CEE483DC49E6B3E61BAF9D3E3FE
dialogue.line: Foolishly loyal to the bitter end...

dialogue.speaker: 32E2E7B6470EC82A0099D58481D41476
dialogue.line: Fuck! Another one!

dialogue.speaker: D5376C994033C09D9448059093309407
dialogue.line: Grr! Arrogant scum!

dialogue.speaker: F591EC33468C600B4BBF18A7C7168EA3
dialogue.line: He will suffer for all eternity, once we've killed him.

dialogue.speaker: C90377424635739D90DA01B5C55EA9FE
dialogue.line: He won’t make it without help.

dialogue.speaker: 4784AE4F44EF2B7A631280803776CA2E
dialogue.line: He’s alive. Barely.

dialogue.speaker: C9BE1E8D4CF31981A865C09B13862B2F
dialogue.line: Honestly, I don’t give a damn about Catalin.

dialogue.speaker: 758F2F564C78EE8B378255A62033C945
dialogue.line: I can't wait to rip his heart out of his chest.

dialogue.speaker: 9BBB0271481D56E133DA32845FFCA53A
dialogue.line: I fucking despise them.

dialogue.speaker: 969012E24AE634F8DD890EBEAE565096
dialogue.line: I should have seen this coming. I should...

dialogue.speaker: FECE12234AB3ECCA1BA11385A3226DB9
dialogue.line: I wonder how many more enemies await us before the throneroom.

dialogue.speaker: B2340557494ED8BA5E3EDF9C1E940B44
dialogue.line: I wonder if he knows we're coming for him.

dialogue.speaker: 0485DF7C44CB38DCA8E015BF9707BE2B
dialogue.line: I wonder what it must’ve been like growing up here. In this dark, cold castle…

dialogue.speaker: 03EF587447C44AF0ABD0598F04463DA9
dialogue.line: I wouldn’t trade it for my family's hut, to be honest.

dialogue.speaker: 0276126D4666DAC2C081649985270EFA
dialogue.line: I'm here to save my family, first and foremost.

dialogue.speaker: 44CB066E47ABD3A481AC658E459E1E44
dialogue.line: I'm tearing these damn wings off!

dialogue.speaker: 97D996BD4AD8BCC78EAA2B9E51769472
dialogue.line: If it comes to that, we’ll face it. But don’t give up just yet.

dialogue.speaker: 883636FD4CFF1B55DA496193404457EA
dialogue.line: It will all be over come dawn. I'll have my revenge.

dialogue.speaker: 0D8BDC26420C928C684CA7B881BC8501
dialogue.line: It's Brencis I'm after.

dialogue.speaker: A6A52760402599452DAA2C832F8DA07A
dialogue.line: I’ve a bad feeling about this mystery ritual.

dialogue.speaker: 667330D541D49F0F0E9A6D9E64555F76
dialogue.line: Like father, like son, I guess...

dialogue.speaker: DE14E6C24C60252D6103DCBB11D762C2
dialogue.line: Maybe. But we need to face this head-on, not waste time stalling.

dialogue.speaker: 90B671664A22CB65D888658C30EE5708
dialogue.line: Me too. What if he’s using my family for it...?

dialogue.speaker: 505BE2A247D0C1D5539035BDB478F319
dialogue.line: My men are buying us time.

dialogue.speaker: B8333C1A45289350F1679393136D3BC9
dialogue.line: Never thought I'd see Skender like this.

dialogue.speaker: 34DF8F8F4E67561A6265E5A60CCDCBF0
dialogue.line: No surprise there. Ambrus favoured proud fools like himself.

dialogue.speaker: 6A38AB0A4804BEAADCE8C8BFC22C1D5C
dialogue.line: No time to waste. We need to find that entrance to the throneroom.

dialogue.speaker: 870C0B4A41B022C794F598BE0E12EEC9
dialogue.line: Not sure how much time we've lost... But I hope Catalin and my men haven’t gone too far.

dialogue.speaker: E5E1C3114F1ED6A45E25F9967A981706
dialogue.line: Oh, fuck!

dialogue.speaker: 2022B7CB48EAC01F803F329914914395
dialogue.line: Oh, she was just tired of babysitting you lot.

dialogue.speaker: 9FC47C4946DA6BCEFDA6CBB7FFFDDEFD
dialogue.line: Oh, that was meant to be a trap? We barely noticed.

dialogue.speaker: F331E3074B4873A677C02EBA2143A639
dialogue.line: Old crone's done for... Now it’s Brencis’s turn.

dialogue.speaker: B9196C084211E8613FA560A1154C09FB
dialogue.line: Only a few, hopefully.

dialogue.speaker: F77198FE45CF753161193CB9F7EE341E
dialogue.line: Rather determined. I think they were trying to avenge their master.

dialogue.speaker: C47DB4FD47273C4C65BD84AE5FA3AE74
dialogue.line: Remember about the hex, Coen!

dialogue.speaker: E48524014E9AEDCB4C920680843608A3
dialogue.line: So much for the blood slaves... Now it’s Brencis’s turn.

dialogue.speaker: 213FFF94467080441BA63CA3C471B60C
dialogue.line: There it is! The throneroom!

dialogue.speaker: C31274994BC7FBAD3A4CB39836BB3991
dialogue.line: There! Door.

dialogue.speaker: 9062497641012EC8F8E2CD85B573704C
dialogue.line: They better be here, Marat. They have to be alive.

dialogue.speaker: 5C906DD44DB310604881C997E84C39B0
dialogue.line: Those weren't just slaves. Tougher than that.

dialogue.speaker: A88E60FC422A1E16C95D5D8BBE2C137F
dialogue.line: Uh-huh. But this silence... this emptiness, it just feels wrong. Like something worse is coming.

dialogue.speaker: 3217622545A60D283F4A109E31E6B5CA
dialogue.line: Wait! Look over there. My men... they’re right on the other side of that gate!

dialogue.speaker: C8E5ECAE41ED21F4C1116D87F81E385A
dialogue.line: Watch out! It swoops again!

dialogue.speaker: 0D0946AC4FCE44FF6E8AD9A2385DC508
dialogue.line: We don’t have time for this, Coen. Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: 326B9E444E5E1C5719A9DE8394840066
dialogue.line: We need to get to the castle – fast!

dialogue.speaker: 69C7CF2E45B06543500643AA1811EA3A
dialogue.line: We'll get there soon. Stay focused.

dialogue.speaker: A3010D3B4062ECD8FBE2D3A46BF639E4
dialogue.line: Well, at least Ambrus won’t be a problem anymore.

dialogue.speaker: DEB59E3E4C278201A0FF9EB876370654
dialogue.line: We’ll find them, Coen. Even if it means tearing this place apart.

dialogue.speaker: 9F7C0ABA46BEBA73FDD954B8DEA5484B
dialogue.line: What if they're dead? What if we just find their rotting bodies?

dialogue.speaker: CB5DE60F45965F14B885F588850363D5
dialogue.line: What the hell?! The boyaress's trap... How did you get out?

dialogue.speaker: 8D8AE0004236FF4D5D6C64B06F9C4CF2
dialogue.line: What? As far as I know, she’s still alive.

dialogue.speaker: 2351F942491BD023BF2B52B06C0E9EBA
dialogue.line: What?! Why did the boyaress let you pass?

dialogue.speaker: 09E662FC41DB3529D85526A966162D57
dialogue.line: Where could they be...? Where did that bastard hide my family?

dialogue.speaker: F831EF764D56AFA8A9B295A2F1012EAA
dialogue.line: Where is that bloody throneroom...?

dialogue.speaker: 609397304EF4E90A2F7B5984C48923E4
dialogue.line: Would be better for us to surprise him, but I wouldn't count on it.

dialogue.speaker: C6C579DE4E058BA91CE505B57522DC01
dialogue.line: Xanthe's gone. They might be starved.

dialogue.speaker: 50960AAE421C7EFB3CE2659B9648A84E
dialogue.line: Yeah, but... you'll see.

dialogue.speaker: 90E50BAE4C923925AFEC7BA9FD3726C3
dialogue.line: Yeah. Agreed.

dialogue.speaker: 8D08272C4D3CDDD60D7A2A87156CA44C
dialogue.line: Yeah. Now it’s Brencis’s turn.

dialogue.speaker: ADBAF4A04262D00F68B718BE6DC706B8
dialogue.line: You and me both, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 699146B647CB26D36736168FCFF0F1C7
dialogue.line: You kill him for me, you hear...!

dialogue.speaker: 24114FCB40B341938983C2BDAA3BF71D
dialogue.line: You mean Ambrus? Yeah, right... Makes sense.

dialogue.speaker: 03E1E8844B21F368BE695B9419C732E3
dialogue.line: [sigh] One hell of a mess so far, eh?

dialogue.speaker: B2F6EE6146D8BDCBC9A7949BD35E51B1
dialogue.line: And Drogos...?

dialogue.speaker: C962C8BC4C358A0BE0AD8D90715D5A4F
dialogue.line: And expose your unit to an attack from behind?

dialogue.speaker: 7F1133194DF00F06C29C9E9AF6011E81
dialogue.line: And exposed your unit? You did well to stay.

dialogue.speaker: 23EA8FD042A393CDC809E492DE85500B
dialogue.line: And? Speak, for fuck's sake!

dialogue.speaker: 16BD52514B45FD598412A9B72CCD94E1
dialogue.line: Aye. Drogos told me to protect our backs, hold my position no matter what... So I just watched them getting slaughtered.

dialogue.speaker: 0D34DCF34442A785D0D6D4BBE4CCF3FA
dialogue.line: Dead.

dialogue.speaker: 9AC4325C4EC7E08A5AD8C2B31E8D2173
dialogue.line: Don't call him that.

dialogue.speaker: FA5102C9429D9B6A21E359A96F344969
dialogue.line: Don't call him that.

dialogue.speaker: CC192419406AE86035D75AB8610215D1
dialogue.line: Enough.

dialogue.speaker: A9B70A16460DE4EE3704BBA312171A4C
dialogue.line: For once, we agree.

dialogue.speaker: 2FC41606478E0B79CDA111BF9C844ED9
dialogue.line: Fucking idiot.

dialogue.speaker: 2FB1D5E74678E7457462AEA2DCABE180
dialogue.line: Go get that bastard. Make him pay for Laslea.

dialogue.speaker: BB25B29D4B6C7D50E82A048176CAA982
dialogue.line: He rushed into combat, let Brencis's men surround us. It was carnage.

dialogue.speaker: DD9A5EB543EE7D4C6D17158675C070FE
dialogue.line: How are you holding up?

dialogue.speaker: B1502DF3486AD2F1A0F611ADCF3C56F3
dialogue.line: I don't know about idiot... But yeah, he wasn't cut out for this.

dialogue.speaker: 40F0C2A3452B9F9A1B1C1692C2E86001
dialogue.line: I told him to hold his position, protect our back... But he knew better.

dialogue.speaker: DF110A3D4979C5779E2415B4A5C5F53D
dialogue.line: I'll call him whatever I please. Shit on his grave, too, if I so fancy.

dialogue.speaker: A4A9BE2648A23DA8313E37A37F9DF398
dialogue.line: I... I could've saved him.

dialogue.speaker: DD109AB1475B7D72BBD786B7FB606BEB
dialogue.line: Idiot, I don't know... But he wasn't cut out for this.

dialogue.speaker: 6ED5681A493B5565CA990088BC85B4E8
dialogue.line: It went about as well as you'd imagine. Drogos is dead... And many others, too.

dialogue.speaker: EA93D4BC4F4FA2741B3214B7C346FBCD
dialogue.line: Keep on fighting, Vlad. May we meet again.

dialogue.speaker: 589B044C4A719F59EA7B8CA0CC83E8FF
dialogue.line: May we meet again.

dialogue.speaker: A750EDC34713D7FA2C364E905867766C
dialogue.line: May we meet again.

dialogue.speaker: AF0D3CF84E37CE702230EDB979B996E2
dialogue.line: No point in splitting hairs now.

dialogue.speaker: F8E0B0254440E5564E889EAD9BD2234E
dialogue.line: No point in splitting hairs now.

dialogue.speaker: 7DE2B298498015392348628B532BEBDE
dialogue.line: No. I've got plenty more. But this isn't the time.

dialogue.speaker: B28A00534C3E21AC29CEAA93E66D1315
dialogue.line: Not while Brencis is alive.

dialogue.speaker: 42C6183C4587338F13EF2F8465C47FF5
dialogue.line: Recklessness and idealism... A dangerous combination. But we couldn't afford to be picky with our recruits.

dialogue.speaker: 6D05228E40232E21DB266B9FF52431FF
dialogue.line: Regroup and keep on fighting. Go, go, go!

dialogue.speaker: 5D8621544A9A7FEA60FFF59DB0DDD105
dialogue.line: That's all you have to say?

dialogue.speaker: 3D12B94148902C2F6D96529D15803C76
dialogue.line: That's all you've got to say?

dialogue.speaker: D6A4D84141E1B40CFF0BEB8E8B1EA834
dialogue.line: The odds were long, but... We would've made it, if it wasn't for that damned fool, Vlad.

dialogue.speaker: 4728DABA43062B2C54DA37A37633E5EF
dialogue.line: Time to go. We'll mourn the fallen later.

dialogue.speaker: BB9FBC784AFFBE9447EBC5AF5E43A14A
dialogue.line: Ugh, Catalin's men, they ordered us to take the arsenal. Frontal attack.

dialogue.speaker: EA02556941F8A7C13C28D4B37FF661D2
dialogue.line: Vlad! You're alive!

dialogue.speaker: 087CAF214A89B03B159104B3573A30DC
dialogue.line: We knew there'd be sacrifices. Keep on fighting.

dialogue.speaker: C98E54D743865E7F03AE8A857386652C
dialogue.line: We must kill Brencis. Whatever the cost.

dialogue.speaker: 8E211BFB480330DFC35A509EC21E01C3
dialogue.line: We took it.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: What?

dialogue.speaker: BB0918764C128E472AED829842A0B29B
dialogue.line: What? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: 7D09AF904D8C4D9EF246CC90477359A4
dialogue.line: You did well to follow your orders.

dialogue.speaker: 423A71CB47EAD2D9B1B371966605685E
dialogue.line: …In this life, or the next.

dialogue.speaker: 8B9FC7214B7A845B7AADCFA8D4FE4C46
dialogue.line: …We told them we don't have enough men, but... They wouldn't listen.

dialogue.speaker: 2A4313264C733E732F9D3DBDF91FA74E
dialogue.line: I... It wasn't always easy, being your son.

dialogue.speaker: E314868A47CA8EC7E839A1857E9F94E0
dialogue.line: And?

dialogue.speaker: 09A11A0847E1BD17290B6D81E1DD34F5
dialogue.line: And? What did he say?

dialogue.speaker: D05BCDFE488E9A2A584AADAD579DCB52
dialogue.line: Aye. It's the truth.

dialogue.speaker: 0252195D4248B95E6267D5A2ECFCF871
dialogue.line: But I never doubted your decency. Your good heart.

dialogue.speaker: 7830B5EA4AFFA5E0A9F43DA636082463
dialogue.line: But Lunka –

dialogue.speaker: 7ECAA63B4B038816375EDB9158F9803E
dialogue.line: But he didn't make it all up?

dialogue.speaker: 68CE28C44370BEA3E837318FD681CBB2
dialogue.line: Coen... The things I've done...

dialogue.speaker: FD53D8924BC16EB3286FC78F9F388872
dialogue.line: Don't let this eat away at you. Please.

dialogue.speaker: B50356B449A98D60FADA27B4C6E2575B
dialogue.line: Eventually... But yes. I'm starting to think it's possible.

dialogue.speaker: 0747C7A1469B5CE38319CFAC06DC5A72
dialogue.line: Godspeed.

dialogue.speaker: A9B226FC48A96E9033C6A9BEC747E68D
dialogue.line: Good. Violence... It only feeds on itself. Grows.

dialogue.speaker: 3A2898BE4532F1659B38A7AAE888AADC
dialogue.line: Ha. Guess you didn't hang out with him long enough to see his true colours, then.

dialogue.speaker: 0C805D5C4886BA5DD146928E40578180
dialogue.line: He did, yes.

dialogue.speaker: 2D1D89164A65B4626E6EE09225C9BD6D
dialogue.line: He didn't leave me much choice.

dialogue.speaker: 6E40F1A340B85C9D637496ADD268E25C
dialogue.line: He told me stories about your past. Some... Some were pretty wild.

dialogue.speaker: D72F3B494051A8FF11A58CBB738A6B97
dialogue.line: He told me stories about your past...

dialogue.speaker: 858AF9D148BE53CA9C366E96BB8DA170
dialogue.line: He won't betray anyone ever again.

dialogue.speaker: D7D490624120D157BA13D095D9E43644
dialogue.line: How am I feeling? What do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 7D3AA7D6405B6D7446D5629358B85C59
dialogue.line: How are you feeling today?

dialogue.speaker: F1526AB245CD9E97CCCF5BAF9440B002
dialogue.line: How are you feeling today?

dialogue.speaker: 428CBF0D4550B2BE773EE0A0BC85C371
dialogue.line: I don't know... Tired? But in a good way. Like, looking forward to a good night's rest.

dialogue.speaker: 98852876472833CC0E0991A63046CE5B
dialogue.line: I had the strangest experience - I saw Alin.

dialogue.speaker: 68B1A983495C518D439C18A22FB59A72
dialogue.line: I hoped you'd never hear of that. Never learn the shameful truth about your father.

dialogue.speaker: 7F6547EF4950B30D2E9CBD815E805351
dialogue.line: I imagine he tried to play you, one way or another.

dialogue.speaker: 0568E109494BD811AE5E049F747E998B
dialogue.line: I know about Cassel. And the treasure.

dialogue.speaker: 04366566415A00B435D3E78E7DE3F7C5
dialogue.line: I know about the treasure.

dialogue.speaker: 0C11F6834AA82A6FB786229C47FE5C56
dialogue.line: I met Volk.

dialogue.speaker: 7934F1134B7F0CCC4E6F128278A0120F
dialogue.line: I see where you're coming from, but no. He actually stood up for me.

dialogue.speaker: C863A6BC41DA2241EF2FAD8AC61338F8
dialogue.line: I should've known better. With more time, I could've –

dialogue.speaker: AB3C19BB436D943471716FB44772D28B
dialogue.line: I swear to God, you ask the strangest questions.

dialogue.speaker: 199515FF4DC58B4639AF589C0EB9C047
dialogue.line: I told you to do it.

dialogue.speaker: 1207265C43B0E87544E1E7B79E14A5EA
dialogue.line: I'm not ashamed of you.

dialogue.speaker: A7F11F444798DAD487478EB25E7AFED4
dialogue.line: I'm not ashamed of you.

dialogue.speaker: 4BD877F0476B2C76251405874BF4820F
dialogue.line: I'm not proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: 8E64DC9F4DA55E721F8D509EF01630B9
dialogue.line: I'm regretting siding with Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: EA6AF2204BE9279413374F94EC466EEE
dialogue.line: I'm regretting striking a deal with Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 9C8C6B6840E2812D04F633988B8CECCA
dialogue.line: I'm sorry. You didn't deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: A041775F44AB3B419F3BD89F71C41D67
dialogue.line: I'm sure he was exaggerating.

dialogue.speaker: 7079A6824D6ACB431306C9BECC67EF34
dialogue.line: I've got to go now.

dialogue.speaker: E38229E248023C0BF1D0F6B4420C9BFF
dialogue.line: I've got to go.

dialogue.speaker: C072D1A44C1A702E96A887BDEE28008B
dialogue.line: I... had the strangest experience, a while back. I saw Alin.

dialogue.speaker: 8679C89D4853C6FE0CEADEB78CB544C1
dialogue.line: It came close to blows. But... in the end, I just walked away.

dialogue.speaker: DA037CD24F8B3C961E63CE8CE1C96FEA
dialogue.line: It's alright, dad. It's alright.

dialogue.speaker: EECC1CB04538992D17CFDF9A919E1555
dialogue.line: Just that.

dialogue.speaker: 47D8791942DB10B8176DAC960BFCA0C9
dialogue.line: Mum just spoke to me!

dialogue.speaker: A7D6377D412D3E6E8AE26389E220ADF3
dialogue.line: Mum just spoke to me!

dialogue.speaker: B7AB87324662DCEE0896DDA3657B5589
dialogue.line: Oh, thanks be to God.

dialogue.speaker: A04C3D50419A1841C8CE6E9FAE0947B9
dialogue.line: Only a little.

dialogue.speaker: F283A2F442F5D0806713C2A5D5E2A3D0
dialogue.line: Really? Huh. People do change, then.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: Shit.

dialogue.speaker: 5FB68D6B40D3D3330CC1C99AF222E9E6
dialogue.line: So you...?

dialogue.speaker: 0473D9804E7B693AB82EF9B78102E1C1
dialogue.line: Sort of.

dialogue.speaker: 460AC25D47DAFA7C4DABF395DC8ABDD6
dialogue.line: Thank you, son.

dialogue.speaker: 648959414497D45C75DDBCA31C598F28
dialogue.line: That I shouldn't blame myself. For what happened.

dialogue.speaker: E999F2C54989C01F289A638DF2591DA8
dialogue.line: They were awful, yes. But you're not the same man.

dialogue.speaker: C2787B8E4E0E1722086D499E3E4A5DE3
dialogue.line: Think she might get better? Eventually?

dialogue.speaker: 79E389FA4F8D9DDB61C3D282C4D29C92
dialogue.line: Thought, yes. But I might've felt differently, for a time.

dialogue.speaker: F987F1384BF9F576881A46B925897C0C
dialogue.line: Well... It's probably for the best.

dialogue.speaker: F5E7402947AE2AD5FF0003A5A88EDDFC
dialogue.line: What do you mean? In a dream?

dialogue.speaker: 2C116AB14D28C9952E3DA3A79C8E2B55
dialogue.line: With more time, we would've gone mad from pain and terror. All of us.

dialogue.speaker: BA9EA51B4BABA44E3BA70D873989A9A4
dialogue.line: Yes, Coen?

dialogue.speaker: BD6CAD434B9BAE92AB60C4A8B6B24E80
dialogue.line: You did the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: 3F1C436644B9DFF7CBCBF2BEFACD2623
dialogue.line: You did what you thought was best. No point in second-guessing, in what-ifs.

dialogue.speaker: 91FFE542440D6BB1704A58ADFEDEF923
dialogue.line: You might be interested to know I had the chance to meet Volk.

dialogue.speaker: E5E9FF444AD42B46204A51A7B6BF22FE
dialogue.line: You've always thought so?

dialogue.speaker: 9550AA23498091B07E1624AFCC9E3730
dialogue.line: You've atoned for your sins.

dialogue.speaker: FA949B304B8EA89A75DA1B8ECCE44284
dialogue.line: You've atoned for your sins.

vt_e: How about I just finish it?
You people live here? All year?

dialogue.speaker: 4EC5242B497E24DAF0BA57AB733FCBC8
dialogue.line: Don't think there's anything more to find here. Time to go.

dialogue.speaker: 00600584468A3B7AE97491A2782551D9
dialogue.line: Good thing he didn't ruin the cross beyond repair.

dialogue.speaker: 1506BA9A4D24B63B887390A8E7D159F9
dialogue.line: Guess that's all.

dialogue.speaker: 6C1C84A3471AC42E95C3698EF1CEB5F6
dialogue.line: His wife betrayed him, so he destroyed the shrine she held more sacred than their vows? Bit on the nose, if you ask me.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male05
dialogue.line: Hmm...

dialogue.speaker: A5244DAB45EAD8196F2B80BFA80A331B
dialogue.line: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

dialogue.speaker: 37D9780047725C430AACC4B777700852
dialogue.line: Someone marked a verse – Deuteronomy twelve, twenty-three...

dialogue.speaker: 3705397C471296CEA11021BACCB8131C
dialogue.line: Yeah, seems about right.

dialogue.speaker: ACC5B6884BDBC9F6D7E6FDBA62E68978
dialogue.line: A doctor of some renown. That is until he began to dabble in dark practices...

dialogue.speaker: 3A93ACCE472133206FAEDAA6710F226F
dialogue.line: All right. Where can we find him?

dialogue.speaker: E33EADC04BD12DA561CBC4B12DBF691F
dialogue.line: Go, friend. And may God protect you.

dialogue.speaker: BA1454B44A217FE97ED2D29BF5EC6BCF
dialogue.line: Ha! Nu, making promises you can’t keep?

dialogue.speaker: 8E8DCB7B4CE9410B625BEE835F64006D
dialogue.line: Have something else to do first. I'll join you there.

dialogue.speaker: C58FD06D4980F6DD6AE424886F2B2EAE
dialogue.line: He stole secret knowledge from various traditions, including our sacred books.

dialogue.speaker: 4076B83C49BE94F06E3C09B7A8696167
dialogue.line: He used Kabbalah?

dialogue.speaker: 2F7EE9DB47A865F1288E6594668111FF
dialogue.line: He was burnt at the stake by the inquisition in Toledo. Or at least that's how the story goes.

dialogue.speaker: 1A73737E401512C7C6731D9865C80A4A
dialogue.line: He's no tale, but a man of flesh and bone. A very dangerous one.

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male05
dialogue.line: Hmm...

dialogue.speaker: E730A2E3401A1B470A39CA89533CB0F1
dialogue.line: How did he create these living objects?

dialogue.speaker: BFEB61014863FD1ED7AC3F88B325A48B
dialogue.line: How did he manage to create these living objects?

dialogue.speaker: 0C16B992479F1DC49CAD2AAEF9EEF71E
dialogue.line: I fear we're endangering them all.

dialogue.speaker: 62D1950A4C8FC369056BE9A9B03DDBCD
dialogue.line: I fear we're endangering them all.

dialogue.speaker: B41961B7429DB47EA9836AB8C24B541A
dialogue.line: I know the legends, recognise the inscription... but that's all.

dialogue.speaker: 7F17F06246B834870D4B15B013BDA1C2
dialogue.line: I need to do something else first.

dialogue.speaker: 00EC19904B3CEE6A024090849AA5753A
dialogue.line: I see that rings a bell.

dialogue.speaker: 5471766F404BBA21EA8BF28A9A48B50E
dialogue.line: In a grave, most likely. He lived over a century ago.

dialogue.speaker: 4C926895424AD6A870F2AF85B972A40E
dialogue.line: Is there any way to kill such things?

dialogue.speaker: 5223082B4AEC94536521C5995B01CC5B
dialogue.line: Is there any way to kill such things?

dialogue.speaker: 39A660824BF35553CBF931B7F731388E
dialogue.line: It's nothing. Forget it.

dialogue.speaker: 39B9E0E041B008500A06BA9186ACF536
dialogue.line: It's nothing. Forget it.

dialogue.speaker: 0147B38E44AB10E70790838BA57C7A2F
dialogue.line: Just don't leave me hanging for too long. There's no time to spare.

dialogue.speaker: FA14C4244D0FADF83E41BE8112E63FFE
dialogue.line: Legend has it, he found a way to breathe life into objects... And suck it out of the living.

dialogue.speaker: 5F2AC6694BC5354090A45E9FC9FA4F84
dialogue.line: My best guess is that if there were a way, Silas would have documented it.

dialogue.speaker: 0BD41CC546EF3D40417D0E85EED2955D
dialogue.line: New reign, new beginnings.

dialogue.speaker: BFBAF0144334F200B9585C98E35B16CB
dialogue.line: No idea. I chased her away before she had the chance to say much else.

dialogue.speaker: 9842667049A6CB50E446F7B968D6B7D9
dialogue.line: Not only used – rewrote, desecrated, and combined it with the unholy and accursed.

dialogue.speaker: CE1FADBE49BE025C23B81AA0CA5EF2CD
dialogue.line: Oh, Lord forbid! No.

dialogue.speaker: 5AFFA28045E80962C91DBB93D8FFAC56
dialogue.line: One of the reasons I didn't want to have anything to do with it.

dialogue.speaker: C5A89FD543972DFF18A3AA8574D50CC3
dialogue.line: Right behind you.

dialogue.speaker: E13E393E45679260EFD10AAA573D73DA
dialogue.line: She was talking about gathering research for her master, so... it seems likely.

dialogue.speaker: C0691F124C56C81AB5D412825A7CB77E
dialogue.line: Silas's research isn't something I’m willing to discuss with just anyone.

dialogue.speaker: C08420034E49B6F5D3E124BA328ACDF0
dialogue.line: So Silas posed as a cobbler...?

dialogue.speaker: 9F36CABC467A433C11F2C19F5C208613
dialogue.line: Sure, right behind you.

dialogue.speaker: 323006D84B29494FA99763B8BC11C760
dialogue.line: Thank you, Mevasser. We won’t trouble you anymore.

dialogue.speaker: DC22DE98436432566882CDB178BD25E8
dialogue.line: Then what is this?

dialogue.speaker: 904BAE0E4245101BC0DB639032A037B8
dialogue.line: They all used to have their workshops on the same street, just over in Altenmarkt.

dialogue.speaker: 7FB18010450991BBD2ABC9B6A286C870
dialogue.line: They were in danger to begin with. We're here to change that.

dialogue.speaker: 50FEE70941D05660CCCF6B977E1F067E
dialogue.line: This inscription reminds me of Silas... Funnily enough, a young woman came by not long ago inquiring about him, too.

dialogue.speaker: 448FA21D4D636283292194BC58F0B016
dialogue.line: Very well. Let's go check it out, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 43A50A4A4536359CEFE22C8167474674
dialogue.line: Wait here.

dialogue.speaker: 2E98D9E24BD4B9FDC9D26CA86F4B903C
dialogue.line: Wait. Aurelius? The evil sorcerer from the old hags's tales?

dialogue.speaker: B9816023400FDFEBCBBCAEB6429A2B75
dialogue.line: Well, not long ago, I would have argued there's no need since 'such things' couldn't exist at all. But then again, I'd say the same about vrakhiri...

dialogue.speaker: BBEAAC1744D7B30F460B7484FCFF867D
dialogue.line: Well, see for yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 4A313DA8439667EB3CB607B7A901AA18
dialogue.line: Well, she was talking about gathering research for her master. But I don't think she meant the knyaz.

dialogue.speaker: 9642E22E4B29D056102847A0337E19B3
dialogue.line: Well? Aren't you glad we talked him round?

dialogue.speaker: 58DA3FC24229AB2062ED2B8881E8B69A
dialogue.line: What happened to Silas in the end?

dialogue.speaker: A86DD28947B67407A6F9A9805EC25A7E
dialogue.line: What happened to him in the end?

dialogue.speaker: C21136134715C372CAF341ACD24B1720
dialogue.line: What young woman? Did she work for Aurelius?

dialogue.speaker: 1191999D467EE3979F1D2EBBAE26A320
dialogue.line: What young woman? Someone from Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: E18273F6427925F04B9837A2F989A303
dialogue.line: What young woman? Someone from Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: 6EEE9D094C201B0356FC479482EFEE1A
dialogue.line: What young woman? Was she working for Aurelius?

dialogue.speaker: C35F1A5444838E806789389521BE0091
dialogue.line: Who is this Silas?

dialogue.speaker: FF3D4811424DEFEB8D751E96B3A9102C
dialogue.line: Who knows? Maybe even his notes are still there. Although I wouldn’t hold my breath.

dialogue.speaker: 6C9342984727E1ACCF34DF8F0FA420E9
dialogue.line: Who then?

dialogue.speaker: 532CCA72420CBF64400FB88235374C29
dialogue.line: Who's Silas?

dialogue.speaker: 3E5C55174E5C76FA1342C889B61495C4
dialogue.line: Whose reign...?

dialogue.speaker: 853ADF6241B09F862CA9138E9F169A09
dialogue.line: Yeah. It certainly does.

dialogue.speaker: D59FBB1B43B025902B879698D1671069
dialogue.line: You wouldn’t happen to have Silas's notes?

dialogue.speaker: 971516564B05A6EEF5356D956C5C3A03
dialogue.line: You wouldn’t happen to just have... Silas's notes, would you?

dialogue.speaker: 33DFA7A84E3AD7C7A906ED9B105D1384
dialogue.line: Your friend here seems to know it.

dialogue.speaker: 48A4F5044BB8FB9C1ECCB3AD137F9332
dialogue.line: You’re in no position to make such a promise.

dialogue.speaker: 0FAA996E4AB2D003CE12F2B00EB637E0
dialogue.line: You’re in no position to make such a promise. One victory won’t erase centuries of prejudice.

dialogue.speaker: B52113694CE844C7733213B318E38521
dialogue.line: You’re saying his shop could be there?

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Woman1
dialogue.line: I can't wait for Hiban's wedding. The spring can't come soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Worker2
dialogue.line: You're right. It's just... it's hard, is all.

dialogue.speaker: c.c.ForestTavern.Civilian.Family.Brother
dialogue.line: They even helped us with the wall.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Woman4
dialogue.line: I think we'd need a few more wrinkles to remedy that, heh.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Cartographer
dialogue.line: When you actually learn what I'm trying to teach you and prove it to me.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Woman3
dialogue.line: Whatever you think of, it will be more interesting than the truth, I bet.

dialogue.speaker: c.c.ForestTavern.Civilian.Family.Elder
dialogue.line: I've had it with these louts in here. Place was better when I made the rules: No soldiers. No if and buts.

dialogue.speaker: c.c.ForestTavern.Civilian.Family.Wife
dialogue.line: Well, I'm afraid to go get anything right now, inside or outside. I liked the animals better.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Woman2
dialogue.line: Oh, I could use some good, drunken fun too. Just hope the soldiers won't bother us again.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Worker1
dialogue.line: You'd no longer be wondering anything. You'd be dead.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Soldier.Xanthe.Captain
dialogue.line: What's gotten into you?! Are you a soldier or a lout?!

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Soldier.Bakir.Troublemaker3
dialogue.line: Chug, lad, chug! Make our boyar proud!

dialogue.speaker: c.c.ForestTavern.Civilian.Family.Elder
dialogue.line: Regrettably, yes. As a child, too. Not a pretty sight.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Woman2
dialogue.line: You know that old farm? Where Jibah used to live?

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.Woman3
dialogue.line: Oh, bugger off, mate. How many times do I have to say it?

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Soldier.Bakir.Troublemaker1
dialogue.line: Yeah, could really use a pretty face at the table. Look at those mugs I'm stuck looking at!

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Soldier.Bakir.Captain
dialogue.line: You're doing it for the money just like I am. We're exactly the same.

dialogue.speaker: cc.ForestTavern.Civilian.CartographerApprentice
dialogue.line: So, if I drink it all, we'll go on an adventure?!

dialogue.line: Saw a couple of strangers skulking about the other day.

dialogue.speaker: q102.old_district_thug3
dialogue.line: Really? Oh shit. I hope they won't bring any guards in here. Like we don't have enough trouble as it is.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Albertus
dialogue.line: The year... Wait, was it? Yes... Anno Domini... 796? No, no. 795.

dialogue.speaker: q102.old_district_thug1
dialogue.line: Yeah? Maybe they had a few denarii on them, hm?

q102_03j_inside_cathedral_04: Yes, that should work... But how about... No, no. Too gaudy. Perhaps...

dialogue.speaker: C7BB193843B40E92FA14159E8A84F6B4
dialogue.line: I'll leave you be.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: What was in the old stained-glass window?

dialogue.speaker: q102.Craftsman
dialogue.line: You're... you're right, of course.

dialogue.speaker: BCE9AED54CB8A99F9EA68F943EF67488
dialogue.line: A pointless act of brutality.

dialogue.speaker: 0A5C65934E228490EFBC368745E0EE9E
dialogue.line: Have you been to the cathedral crypt?

dialogue.speaker: CD6E711D4658F75CD5E2A781BF10FC46
dialogue.line: How's the work going?

dialogue.speaker: C2F6255D4F387AD00E31DABC6AB1CAC1
dialogue.line: I'll leave you be.

dialogue.speaker: 0D54D36A4FC4169F60FE6C95696FD39C
dialogue.line: That's quite morbid.

dialogue.speaker: 2FE9980E427C374EA3C5449EABD46F97
dialogue.line: What happened to it?

dialogue.speaker: 5326F465428DFCE1EFDCDE986241466D
dialogue.line: [DB: C. approaches a craftsman busy with working on a stained glass - camera focus on the glass for a moment]

q102_03l_inside_cathedral_06: Pay the workers, clean up the altar... what else? [sigh] Right, the belltower.

dialogue.speaker: q102.Deacon
dialogue.line: Oh, enough from you. Leave me, child. And be glad I don't give you to the vrakhiri!

dialogue.speaker: q102.Acolyte
dialogue.line: Yeah, but maybe –

dialogue.speaker: q102.Deacon
dialogue.line: [sighs] Still, it seems to me you have plenty of time on your hands and will keep on badgering me.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You must be wrong. I talked with someone who was absolutely positive there are tombs underneath the cathedral.

dialogue.speaker: 1BB1AC794E3F53A57DACDF8F76829108
dialogue.line: Did you report Xanthe?

dialogue.speaker: 3803CDF34BFDBD53DCCD07B79C77880E
dialogue.line: Does it happen often?

dialogue.speaker: 2D42ED0641BB1DCD622FEAA2AC87133C
dialogue.line: He was involved in something.

dialogue.speaker: 36C915AD4410A47821F86D8094676144
dialogue.line: I know what happened to the caretaker.

dialogue.speaker: 1CEAE2D244A2CBAA232B3FBB05633E59
dialogue.line: I'll return later.

dialogue.speaker: B587905A47E6DC0F35A6F9B31C40D5A1
dialogue.line: I'm fine on my own.

dialogue.speaker: 2FB60FA3484EB3B22E48E18D541A84F4
dialogue.line: It was all Xanthe's doing.

dialogue.speaker: 4A64C4DC47E6670ABBDF6BA11B9272B1
dialogue.line: Perhaps they've been built over?

dialogue.speaker: 7853F5EC4BEEF8FDDE624B87E5AAFBF5
dialogue.line: Sorry, don't need anything.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Of-of course, don't want to be any trouble. I'm leaving.

dialogue.speaker: q102.Deacon
dialogue.line: The cathedral is closing for the night. Please leave.

dialogue.speaker: E4D12A124332BFF58B553495F5D540EB
dialogue.line: Of course, I'm going.

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe3
dialogue.line: Shut your traps. If you want to gossip like maids, do so when you're off-duty.

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe5
dialogue.line: I like the uriashi. Can trust them to do the job. And they don't talk too much.

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe6
dialogue.line: Father Florin approached me the other day. 'Thank you for guarding the House of God', he said!

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe4
dialogue.line: They almost don't talk at all! And they're always so serious. Really, how can they get through a night barely saying a word?

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe8
dialogue.line: Have some respect. He's a good man, that Father Florin.

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe7
dialogue.line: If he's so grateful, maybe he could get us out of the blood tax come next Sunday...

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe2
dialogue.line: Why would she come here at all?

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe1
dialogue.line: We're lucky. Boyaress Xanthe is not here tonight.

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe3

dialogue.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe1
dialogue.line: We're lucky. Boyaress Xanthe is not here tonight.

dialogue.speaker: q102.necrospeak_victim
dialogue.line: You won't fucking believe it. He asked her again! I told him: don't be daft.

dialogue.speaker: E991D0BE4B1ED1A3C335498AB21B295E
dialogue.line: Enough. Rest now.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: q102.Nun
dialogue.line: Yes? What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You think differently?

dialogue.speaker: A90784DF42B1193CEE111BAD5B610F31
dialogue.line: Don't blame yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 53D1A4724B097FDBE22E9EBB2D16F773
dialogue.line: He's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: 2FED7E624B7CADEB09D133BDEA744E5F
dialogue.line: It was the caretaker.

dialogue.speaker: 0C09537E46314C441D6A8B8155F74092
dialogue.line: Keep it.

dialogue.speaker: F21E93554115F7E81FAD47948C891EAD
dialogue.line: Nothing, goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: 1BF2A28F4BCDB2A54AC5D7B26733251F
dialogue.line: Sorry, I'll leave you alone.

dialogue.speaker: 385333C54F07D7C060EA988994AF3DEE
dialogue.line: Talk to me and I might help you.

dialogue.speaker: 7F3561B74BB39346E4048BADCC8C0FAB
dialogue.line: That sounded ominous.

dialogue.speaker: 2783025242703C68F6CB3A921C3B145B
dialogue.line: You're here just by yourself?

dialogue.speaker: q102.Servant
dialogue.line: I'm... I'm alright. Just... Need to get a breather thaaa-that's... all.

dialogue.speaker: q102_cathedral_guard1
dialogue.line: The cathedral is closed for the night. Come back in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: q102.Servant
dialogue.line: You're a good man after all, friend! Better than our deacon, that's for sure.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You sure? Maybe it was built over?

dialogue.speaker: 3A72CDD54AD6B74C03E61FB3744BAEA6
dialogue.line: Can you go wherever you please?

dialogue.speaker: 9BDF8A044C675DB2A1236CA631F88AA7
dialogue.line: Got a problem with the deacon?

dialogue.speaker: 9F53EACD42C382E4AE951EAC7A5A726D
dialogue.line: Here, to say sorry.

dialogue.speaker: 78E0F3EC4B5ECE7D7034E39254A3B6EE
dialogue.line: I'm not a snitch.

dialogue.speaker: 33D1CF664DD6D4FF486328ADB5D29F59
dialogue.line: Nothing at the moment.

dialogue.speaker: 35D4B75F4BA880E0DEC80BAD9A3199B1
dialogue.line: That's all, I think.

dialogue.speaker: F22A1E6349DC788BB5CEAE8E887E6ED1
dialogue.line: What's that large building over there?

dialogue.speaker: F53B833C461FBB59284C4F98A1AF76A7
dialogue.line: Where were you standing?

dialogue.speaker: D576858F474B87791517EA8EE185154F
dialogue.line: Where's the caretaker's shed?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Well, don't mind me.

dialogue.speaker: q102.Servant
dialogue.line: You should... shouldn't be here!

dialogue.speaker: 743F9B5A4DABA816C5ED71B41FAE8010
dialogue.line: I'll keep that in mind.

dialogue.speaker: BD050D4641DA7EC5966534A9FCB8A4FF
dialogue.line: Not afraid of the guards?

dialogue.speaker: E59413F543ECD2E4CB22268B8627A780
dialogue.line: Shouldn't you go to a tavern?

dialogue.speaker: 82DB8A35422B9533CD25539861BA2FD7
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

q102_servant_gmpl: Should be getting down to work... Just a little while and I'll begin.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Person2
dialogue.line: Won't be long before those butchers start arresting children too. Mark my words.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Person1
dialogue.line: God, what have we done to deserve this? How many more must die before it's over?

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Person3
dialogue.line: [sob] He had his whole life ahead of him… It’s just not right!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Person2
dialogue.line: Won't be long before those butchers start arresting children too. Mark my words.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Person1
dialogue.line: God, what have we done to deserve this? How many more must die before it's over?

dialogue.line: Won't be long before those butchers start arresting children too. Mark my words.

dialogue.line: God, what have we done to deserve this? How many more must die before it's over?

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Person3
dialogue.line: [sob] He had his whole life ahead of him… It’s just not right!

cc_guard_post_zone2_25_merchant_alarm_gm: Oi, what are you–?! Guards, guards!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yes, I'll buy it.

dialogue.speaker: 2128DBE7470016BC35C48CBE8197FE10
dialogue.line: As you wish – I'm taking this to the commander.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Guard_Post_Trader
dialogue.line: [sigh] Here you go.

dialogue.speaker: 4EA834DA401F4DA63A41FB9402DB618B
dialogue.line: Buy it back?! You should return it to the family.

dialogue.speaker: 1B9B114D4D5AADD787076DBA431D13E8
dialogue.line: I need to go.

dialogue.speaker: 810C80FD4710FC5C2A5CD196598869A7
dialogue.line: I take it you haven’t heard what happened between Cerbus and the overseer?

dialogue.speaker: BE0A62584DA6862BE5431E9C2B17D548
dialogue.line: I won't buy from the likes of you.

dialogue.speaker: 3238B1FC4FF61153816E669BA24F5ED6
dialogue.line: Interesting place to set up a stall.

dialogue.speaker: 0604B3F641BF67E07686898C3D890AD4
dialogue.line: Just show me your merchandise.

dialogue.speaker: 4757253C4EA05E7A9C0DC697D1FD88E2
dialogue.line: Maybe I will ask the commander about it all...

dialogue.speaker: CAF9903946D4C470C59C8FB5E9373830
dialogue.line: Maybe I’ll ask the commander if he knows about all this...

dialogue.speaker: 595D42D34F887162B5D1E392FE06907F
dialogue.line: Show me your merchandise.

Q105_dlg_gmpl_16_Guard_Post_Trader_chatt: You won't find a better deal round here. Ha!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Meeting_Point_Soldier
dialogue.line: We won't let you off the hook this time. Get him!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Meeting_Point_Soldier2
dialogue.line: But, sir!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [inhale] I think I’ll take my leave.

dialogue.speaker: 703148824465A5B341C3789C99A9DD61
dialogue.line: I'm just passing by.

dialogue.speaker: 940674354FA312B812A43D8983FCF0B7
dialogue.line: I... I'll take my leave.

dialogue.speaker: FB1A4F8E4B27C22305D8409957002271
dialogue.line: Not sure. Maybe these coins hold an answer?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: [gasp] W-why...?

dialogue.speaker: 2A273C394C5D2B0EF1B150A875B6CFA2
dialogue.line: That girl is my sister.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah
dialogue.line: Untie me, you bastards!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Meeting_Point_Soldier
dialogue.line: You brought this on yourself, love.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Meeting_Point_Soldier_Soul
dialogue.line: [gurgles]

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [compel soul]

dialogue.speaker: AB355AB744AE6DA20D14ED837EBDB5E6
dialogue.line: [leave]

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_on_post3
dialogue.line: Please! Let me out. I didn't do anything!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prison_Guard
dialogue.line: [scoff] Sounds like none of you did… and yet, here you all are. Makes you wonder, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prison_Guard
dialogue.line: You! You'll be joining him in the cell.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Miller
dialogue.line: [sob] W-what am I going to do...?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: [sigh] Thank God... Wasn't sure he'd take the bait.

dialogue.speaker: 7EE5B6E34ED42F8A01BE4C96B17591A7
dialogue.line: Can she take me to their leader?

dialogue.speaker: 5B4968E54E7BC7D4692566B82A7C8B3E
dialogue.line: I won't free you until you answer my questions.

dialogue.speaker: B49E9C884AE1EA75488EDD87362D81AE
dialogue.line: I'll try to get you out now.

dialogue.speaker: 3C450DD04C2692303B76C3B8288A00EA
dialogue.line: I'm not here to talk about her.

dialogue.speaker: 16232FAB4419BDA0B908E198350CF264
dialogue.line: I'm sorry... Renna is dead.

dialogue.speaker: 9F97227648367103D416C2A294AD6F68
dialogue.line: Jesus. What did the guards do to you?

dialogue.speaker: 1F172C5B49022D901B7E77A996AF55B3
dialogue.line: Jesus... What did the guards do to you?

dialogue.speaker: 2C44B3AA41524526FA87DC834482AFBA
dialogue.line: Jesus... What did they do to you?

dialogue.speaker: 320E1E7E4429B972598D86BDA9E161CD
dialogue.line: One of them?

dialogue.speaker: AEE54A4B4047143E5500E081567D9183
dialogue.line: So you really joined the rebels...

dialogue.speaker: 02D1D7DB4AE18908ECA324ADC955C120
dialogue.line: Tell me about your... friends.

dialogue.speaker: AC565A0F46D80DA205602A89DC2D4DF1
dialogue.line: There's too many of them.

dialogue.speaker: 39A90FCC4C50FE6A1AC943BD03B547E7
dialogue.line: What about Vlad?

dialogue.speaker: 9373DDD14279F8EE40BD94B04F79C737
dialogue.line: Yes, uh – we talked.

dialogue.speaker: 5A4F1A994CEFB7189C658998CABBB112
dialogue.line: You could have lied.

dialogue.speaker: 510ABAB540BBC5B68E03A594970349F7
dialogue.line: You will leave the two of us alone.

dialogue.speaker: B1C3D7F64350526265371687E6C8ED15
dialogue.line: You will leave the two of us alone.

dialogue.speaker: A001506641A2BC0EB28FE5885EEA9313
dialogue.line: [try whispering]

dialogue.speaker: D77327AA4B864DB2A4EFC98D4095A4C1
dialogue.line: [try whispering]

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Post_Soldier1
dialogue.line: There! Cut them off!

dialogue.speaker: Marat
dialogue.line: Fuck! We’ve got to lose them.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prison_Guard
dialogue.line: To arms, men! They’re fleeing!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Post_Soldier3
dialogue.line: Spread out! Block the gates! They can’t hide forever!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Post_Soldier3
dialogue.line: Yeah, yeah. Everybody says so.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_Family
dialogue.line: Why do I need to pay for the appointment? I can’t afford that!

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Post_Soldier2
dialogue.line: So you're a thief and a liar, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_on_post
dialogue.line: No, no more... I beg you...

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Post_Soldier3
dialogue.line: Yeah, yeah. Everybody says so.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_Family

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_on_post3
dialogue.line: Yeah. You know him?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Understood. Thank you.

dialogue.line: I'll search for the keys.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_on_post3
dialogue.line: Thank you! Thank you!

dialogue.line: Oh, God. What have I done...

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Prisoner_on_post3
dialogue.line: Please! Let me out. I didn't do anything!

dialogue.line: [scoff] Sounds like none of you did… and yet, here you all are. Makes you wonder, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Woman_under_Prison_tower
dialogue.line: Pretty sure of it.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You seem upset...

dialogue.speaker: 926D24F64D56B974A07012B0A5CC8DBF
dialogue.line: The guards are stealing from the prisoners...?

Q105_dlg_gmpl_woman_under_prison_tower: I'll tell everyone about your shenanigans! You hear me?! Everyone!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Chase_guard3b
dialogue.line: They're here! Close in!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Chase_guard3
dialogue.line: You won’t get away this time!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Chase_guard3b
dialogue.line: They're here! Close in!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Chase_guard3
dialogue.line: You won’t get away this time!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Church_guard
dialogue.line: You’re not getting away that easily, scum!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Church_guard
dialogue.line: You won't escape alive!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Church_guard2b
dialogue.line: You can’t hide from us, cowards!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Church_guard
dialogue.line: You won't escape alive!

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Brencis_Soldier_Church_guard2b
dialogue.line: You can’t hide from us, cowards!

dialogue.line: [whisper]

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Sarah

dialogue.line: Guess I wasn't far off, calling it a 'guild.'

dialogue.line: Hey! Everyone's already waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: Q106_Rebel_HQ_official_trader
dialogue.line: You...! I know it was you!

cc_rebelhq_official_shop_buyer1_01_gmpl: Seems decent enough... How much is it?

dialogue.line: You know what awaits them? A slow and horrifying death. A death I wouldn't wish on my worst enemies.

dialogue.line: You must run... He's... close... Run!

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yanna? Oh God!

dialogue.speaker: q301_woman
dialogue.line: Help me... Please, help me...

dialogue.line: We’re back home!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Q302.Catalin_Soldier.Choir
dialogue.line: Hooray!!!

dialogue.line: You've made him look like a fool. And if there's one thing he cares about, it's appearances.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: 708.Villager.2
dialogue.line: Not so noble anymore, are we? Not so mighty?

sq708_03_ServantNearMansion: You've decided to come after all? I'm glad.

cc_rebelhq_dining_room_drinking_rebel_05: The odds are shit, but at least the booze is good.

dialogue.line: Ah, shit. My leg... It's worse than I thought.

dialogue.speaker: 0BE0F7EE4C487E5DFCF08E847D7E3144
dialogue.line: Coen?! Hey! I'm a manumit, too! Let me out!

dialogue.speaker: F7EF037A4709D332A6563D9EF6814E99
dialogue.line: Coen?! It's all your fault! It's all on you!

dialogue.speaker: 2314CE71457F88EB1B2A3BBBD1B62692
dialogue.line: Hah. Making amends now?!

dialogue.speaker: 0ED55D1747D3B8629647E7A5C409D591
dialogue.line: Hey! Friend! Help me out!

dialogue.speaker: 9E2901DA44FC8FB578ED43AA6F722BBD
dialogue.line: I need a while. But... thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 081B8F6D43CD4079C12EF28EFF0F8663
dialogue.line: Shit, if my leg weren't broken, I'd put you in this cell myself!

dialogue.speaker: 4D9B2E9E4806BA50869689B91A51A4E6
dialogue.line: The key! It's on one of the bodies!

dialogue.speaker: 1E0930D740CEEDCF25AAC7B09D2CCD65
dialogue.line: Come back here!

dialogue.speaker: 8BF2D844469373AB49E72EB97E90AB91
dialogue.line: Do it!

dialogue.line: Go on!

dialogue.speaker: BBC551FE4E3868A55BC9B7BF3D36191E
dialogue.line: Liar!

vt_e: A bit too close for me.
I just want to live to see us win.
Not a single boring day here.
I'd like the vrakhir to be publicly executed. Nothing would bring me more joy.
Let's see how good you are.
What about less talking and more... Sorry, I'm a bit tense.
You want something, hm? Say it.
Even if we don't win this time... I think we will eventually.
I'm trying not to think about it too much.
Is that for fun or for real?
It was a bad idea, right?
Keep your energy for the fight!
Rain or shine - it doesn't matter.
Don't do it when I'm around.
Go back to where you came from!
I don't want you to be here.
I've killed better men than you!
No use for this right now.
We're all going to die here.
When we're done, I imagine I'll go live a quiet life, you know.
You want me to set you straight?!
Hm. Time for you to bleed!
I hope we get a monument or something. Doesn't have to be huge. But we bloody deserve it, right...? For all the things we're risking?
It's easier to hide when it rains.
Oh, I'll hang you with your own guts!
Oh... Can you do that again?!
Oi, wanna hug me, heh, heh?
This whole thing gets my blood pumping.
Try it with me, you fuck!

dialogue.speaker: AA5FF6A44793394296D513856D322AD9
dialogue.line: A warden's log. With names of people from Laslea. My family's, too.

dialogue.speaker: 6B506686432EEEF525F012857AEDD289
dialogue.line: Ah, you’ll regret taking my family!

dialogue.speaker: A5AAD89344E79C5B2BFC5580CBF069F5
dialogue.line: At least he’ll never lay his filthy hands on anyone again.

dialogue.speaker: 6C395BAF4A9135A09EAD8DB37C669AF7
dialogue.line: Can you feel that? Some kind of presence... behind that gate.

dialogue.speaker: 31D021364A8EE6310A5DD0AD3E5E05F0
dialogue.line: Did you get a good look at their armour...? These were Bakir’s men.

dialogue.speaker: 5E998FB44D1C8D4CAA9997BE424C6A25
dialogue.line: Do you think they moved them out of here... or worse?

dialogue.speaker: 1A2C7B4842E95E60246626BC0E2FFEAE
dialogue.line: Do you think... Did all the prisoners meet the same fate as my family?

dialogue.speaker: 3993B4D54AE173691BC0F88EA9660875
dialogue.line: Father? Yanna? Can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: D2C8AB094352F96500D55C8D57CD61DA
dialogue.line: Find them...

dialogue.speaker: B4B49D184A777F8A7E6B90AA11AAE9B1
dialogue.line: First my men, then the door.

dialogue.speaker: 89D680404FAA2830D3101EB448C45BA1
dialogue.line: Fuck...

dialogue.speaker: E6059D0A45DFA41ADCEBEB811178EB53
dialogue.line: God, that’s sickening.

dialogue.speaker: F526FE594C166301333A43BD8FF662F2
dialogue.line: I believe you spared many from suffering when you took down that madman Bakir.

dialogue.speaker: 0622EE6D486D4E363CC0CC8AFD37BD01
dialogue.line: I don’t even want to imagine the horrors he committed here.

dialogue.speaker: 7548BE1C4C09083C602257B76B61D271
dialogue.line: I just hoped we’d find more.

dialogue.speaker: 46B552834B75B5B8C0824CB15B64AD19
dialogue.line: I knew my family was dead. Of course I did. But seeing it written down...

dialogue.speaker: 907FEF41408935CC7A34DB9D43BC093B
dialogue.line: I recognise these! They were here... My family was imprisoned here.

dialogue.speaker: 46D2975741AD229D0A7A81B742194C19
dialogue.line: It's a warden's log.

dialogue.speaker: 6EEDCB6C4B4BBE94809A01921382417C
dialogue.line: I’ll cut through every last one of you to get to Brencis!

dialogue.speaker: A3BF8AD34773881BB79CDCBB297FE997
dialogue.line: I’ve already killed your Mad Khan!

dialogue.speaker: DEF2FEE644734689C37C6986C35D8D13
dialogue.line: Let's check out these cells...

dialogue.speaker: 9D0BE797401BC984506E1BB30F1A911F
dialogue.line: Marat.

dialogue.speaker: 39B15395454B50822E737B8556EF7869
dialogue.line: No mention of them being killed.

dialogue.speaker: AF78516D493DCC017D10FB8EDBA4EC90
dialogue.line: No use poking around here any longer.

dialogue.speaker: F66C6B224A0684F282B7DBB473669A36
dialogue.line: Not really... But better prepare yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 309028C3449F1E0AD192CDA951566EB7
dialogue.line: Not what the reports suggest.

dialogue.speaker: 7506D6424B6F5291008C058F85FF4286
dialogue.line: One of these doors should lead to the courtyard.

dialogue.speaker: 3BC4F16A442061C179E5BDBB010C9F40
dialogue.line: Rot in hell, Mad Khan...

dialogue.speaker: 794B879946707EA9549C40B5F75815C0
dialogue.line: Serves him right. This man... He took charge of the prisoners after Bakir's death.

dialogue.speaker: BBFA64D2435FEADAD9CF88881D6F3F2F
dialogue.line: Something doesn’t feel right. These cells should be crawling with people.

dialogue.speaker: 931718E54EA319E22E423DBE69541F7B
dialogue.line: Something’s off. These cells shouldn't be empty.

dialogue.speaker: 609309A642894F44CC9D758B6B744386
dialogue.line: That was one tough bastard. Good thing you didn’t try to take him on by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: AA7425684C3F383C8B25B5B5295B1D41
dialogue.line: That’s a relief. They must’ve been moved, just as I suspected.

dialogue.speaker: E5957E8D460901200CEB768DC05DA180
dialogue.line: These... these belonged to my family...

dialogue.speaker: F5066FE54BDFE24432B0EFB2D99EA5E0
dialogue.line: They’ve been keeping a record of every prisoner. Every single thing they did to them...

dialogue.speaker: B2223D5E4200E923764D838D11E473EA
dialogue.line: Think you stand a chance?!

dialogue.speaker: 4F9E32AF4EF5EE2F122FB192E81D67A4
dialogue.line: We’ll avenge them, I swear it, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: F3ACB70249CCAA4CE3B8DF8434E05155
dialogue.line: We’ll save them, don't worry. We're not leaving without them.

dialogue.speaker: 5A1432F843B4DECDAF8C01A98259442F
dialogue.line: What about that door leading to the courtyard?

dialogue.speaker: rebel_male06
dialogue.line: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rebel_male06
dialogue.line: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: F97698034B39DB6FA51D5FB2467E7E2B
dialogue.line: Where have you moved them?! Speak!

dialogue.speaker: 57A4206A4317BE358FB26184CC583B42
dialogue.line: Yeah. Suppose you’re right.

dialogue.speaker: 145096B74130453CE5F23E8970D8B184
dialogue.line: You think he tortured them as well...?

dialogue.speaker: E1D3707F472FA299A55203A2F4B72F43
dialogue.line: [scoff] Nothing...

Put that thing away, dear. That's not what we do here.

dialogue.line: [say nothing]

dialogue.line: You recognise this crest, boy?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Yanna
dialogue.line: Don't you talk about our mother like that.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Lunka
dialogue.line: I want to go home.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Mirto
dialogue.line: Or you'll regret it!

dialogue.line: [sobs]
