dialogue.line: Lie still, Boyan. You're bleeding.

dialogue.speaker: FA484DC849C8B4DB6A5DE49320862517
dialogue.line: No time... He has to know... That thing... killed everyone...

dialogue.speaker: 4C1B9973482FA89FB4CDEA942EBA17B2
dialogue.line: No... Crake...

dialogue.speaker: A45223F44CDD1FEDA81066B93D247D50
dialogue.line: Shh. Hear that? Someone's coming.

dialogue.speaker: 590A2E034C584783A17253B61CFEC256
dialogue.line: Teotim! You must tell Crake... Teotim!

dialogue.speaker: 0F5B71CF48294C7F8BF67F96948FA427
dialogue.line: That 'thing'... W-What was it?

dialogue.speaker: A5E96B024DA5E3B5AF9A01BCAF0A1AC4
dialogue.line: They... They're building an army!

dialogue.speaker: 08B8B83B43948F71671DB190658214FC
dialogue.line: Ugh, I.. I...

dialogue.speaker: A9F792974DFEA5AD8DEB87864A56080A
dialogue.line: Wait. Who's Teotim?

dialogue.speaker: 200F4C9E41689BAFD5FC59B2D9D1C8A0
dialogue.line: Was Layos here with you?

dialogue.speaker: 4BAFF1C7461A9D733110DEA6DD2A937D
dialogue.line: Was Layos here with you?

dialogue.speaker: 58E03EF1431C15CC42677491F760E617
dialogue.line: What do you mean by that 'thing'?

dialogue.speaker: 75596E9F45127F1D831A5D8DCE2D1BE8
dialogue.line: What do you mean by that 'thing'? What was it?

dialogue.speaker: E9A5519C403512E67585829304D2EFB9
dialogue.line: What the – ? What was that?

dialogue.speaker: 706AE44A4B0D52A73DAA5CA1BAE0C64D
dialogue.line: What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: C99E89C147C36E1723D8779CA6A5DBBD
dialogue.line: Wing... I damaged its wing...

dialogue.speaker: 19D705F6454C4839D14BD3B805FEDD0B
dialogue.line: [give in to the hunger]

dialogue.speaker: AF60AAF4417D06582E8F87B18DCC3A11
dialogue.line: [inhales sharply]

cc_city_main_gate_11_old_man_tales_gmpl: The good ones wear our knyaz's crest. Remember what it looks like?

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk.male12
dialogue.line: [clears throat]

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk.female02
dialogue.line: To Hell with the rebels!

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk.male02
dialogue.line: I'm glad I heard that one.

cc_city_market_square_37_armorer_custome: Well, it isn't cheap, especially for custom made sets. But it's worth it.

vt_c: Are you... selling something or what?
Did the shepherd’s dog have pups?
Has anyone told Ida about the well water?
I've seen worse places to live.
Pff! My father used to say that rain is just angels pissing on us.
Will your father buy my veal or not? I need to know!
You aren't really doing this, are you?

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk_old.female02
dialogue.line: You know that those filthy peasants are just waiting for an opportunity to report us to their new master...

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk_old.female01
dialogue.line: She died with her head held high! There are days when I think we'd be better off doing the same....

vt_c: And what if he is the devil?
Did Pola change her prices again?
Is Darik still wearing his father’s boots?
Oh! You made my heart race!
Oh, this weather makes my knees ache.
Shhhh! You'll get us both into trouble.
You look just like my grandson.
You'll get what you deserve. Thief!

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk_old.female02
dialogue.line: You know that those filthy peasants are just waiting for an opportunity to report us to their new master...

dialogue.speaker: vt.c.townsfolk_old.female01
dialogue.line: She died with her head held high! There are days when I think we'd be better off doing the same....

vt_c: Did our blacksmith really fall in the river?
Is Gren still bragging about his harvest?
Maybe, but without the knyaz I'd be dead, lying in a plague pit now.
Might be worth asking someone else.
Say what you will. Drinking blood is a sin.
Think twice before you steal from me, son.
You want a smack round the head?

c_uriash_village_cook_gmpl: This not good for you. Go away.

vt_e: I like human coin. Is very use-ful!
Me too small for you to hit?
You hide sword or I take.
Come! I put end to you!
I know human! Coen of Laz-lee-ah!
That man – I think I know.
Better like this than die sleep.
I big. You hit in the end, hahaha!
I break your little bones, now.
I die, I take you with me!
No fear. I kill, death quick.
Vrakhir powerful. But I kill vrakhir now!
You make trouble. I want no trouble.
You put sword away - or I kill.
Hmph, maybe. But it not good time to talk.
Hmph. And humans say we not be-have…
Humans funny. No horns at all.
I not so easy to defeat!
I tell stop - now I angry!
What wait for? Give your best!
Ci-ty strange. Many people. Many noise.
Hm. I swat you like fly!
I hit next – and I kill!
I not think about this. They not pay I think..
My horns be red with you blood!
You nice, I nice. You not nice – I kill.
You no scary - I show scary!
You think I no see when you no move?
[snort] You get coin already? I need for tavern…

dialogue.speaker: E1174210463CAEFF783DDB890B4900BE
dialogue.line: Let me, butterfingers.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: E19B2B774843C3609E28C098636B84E8
dialogue.line: Sara!!!

dialogue.speaker: catalin_soldier_male04
dialogue.line: Shit.

dialogue.speaker: Q105_Post_Soldier1
dialogue.line: You done here?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Yes, I'm leaving.

dialogue.speaker: 527BD86247425A43EFD8DE9D3FA52383
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: EC2A8A75447AE21BE5FD8DA4D1BFC404
dialogue.line: A great opportunity to prove your mettle.

dialogue.speaker: C0BB19FC42BFB2D95B5F89BB5E004014
dialogue.line: After the scouts vanished, we found him in a tavern, dead drunk, alongside some of Brencis's soldiers.

dialogue.speaker: 3280FBA14F3EE2939A984FB239797A16
dialogue.line: All clear. I'm on it.

dialogue.speaker: FEC14C444FC9F86901DAC486100AF8CB
dialogue.line: All clear. I'm on it.

dialogue.speaker: 2696D83044D152918942CA9A06D3941B
dialogue.line: And I can't afford to lose even more men.

dialogue.speaker: EE12D7FE41E6A2EEEFAD12B44207BA67
dialogue.line: And if you don't?

dialogue.speaker: 7D958A7D4A1776C0F882739D66BB1DBD
dialogue.line: Any idea what happened to the scouts?

dialogue.speaker: 6D9792BB499275594DA91A874EEA0ED4
dialogue.line: Any thoughts? Beyond sheer joy, of course. Or shall we get straight to the point?

dialogue.speaker: 0E49B9C0455DF1DD57628DA0E502D465
dialogue.line: Are you in the habit of inviting people in when they're only half-welcome?

dialogue.speaker: 911D40AF4BE76C9179AF429DDC39E61D
dialogue.line: Brencis's soldiers... they’ve been acting quite suspicious lately.

dialogue.speaker: 5FBB97F94A13974E66C544B913B18DBD
dialogue.line: But first prove to me that you're better man than Brencis.

dialogue.speaker: 197F01894D23AA20C2347986CC1C9A48
dialogue.line: But then, like I told you – it all went quiet.

dialogue.speaker: D3B20D634C5078F1CBA1D6BCFC78EA29
dialogue.line: But you can afford to lose one dodgy half-vrakhir?

dialogue.speaker: F3BB140E44E7C2445C15A6895285DDD5
dialogue.line: But you... you seem to have your ways of remaining unseen. Even with the whole city guard on your heels.

dialogue.speaker: AFE4F31F4ECDFEC48A5C18B88C422D4A
dialogue.line: Coen, this is Layos. Layos, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 91BF022E47902533EB8617AE8C4299D4
dialogue.line: Could you hold off on Layos’ interrogation?

dialogue.speaker: 9AC7EABA4179348817AE4EA7C0336223
dialogue.line: Enough!

dialogue.speaker: D5D64A374CD660BDC86F5FBDF19524A1
dialogue.line: Excuse me?

dialogue.speaker: 1339B9634769CB3B37E49DBA28D7A473
dialogue.line: Feels like you're sending me to a lion's den...

dialogue.speaker: C100A96A4CE3D68EA26960B63DB4EEF7
dialogue.line: Feels like you're sending me to a lion's den...

dialogue.speaker: AAE877DE43A541FE12E1398349F83E36
dialogue.line: Fine, let's talk details.

dialogue.speaker: A3AD0DA84AA4A84149F10B83971CD6A9
dialogue.line: Fine, let’s talk details.

dialogue.speaker: CE01EC83452DF1C4D21D9086EDA2EA21
dialogue.line: Good.

dialogue.speaker: 8622BEEB40251C4A4CF4DBA64367A6AF
dialogue.line: Good. Come.

dialogue.speaker: BC702C9D44836058A220CBBCC8F21F01
dialogue.line: Good. My scouts ought to be keeping watch from the house with the pink façade. Search it. Be sure to check the attic.

dialogue.speaker: 598004E2420BA7ACBB280590FAB54E47
dialogue.line: Have you checked the meeting point?

dialogue.speaker: 53E98F0C4ED8ADCF6BD742AFA3973759
dialogue.line: Have you checked the rendezvous point?

dialogue.speaker: 3E136D2A4710AB96D950789DFF2702DB
dialogue.line: He claimed he arrived at the rendezvous point after his patrol, but no one else was there.

dialogue.speaker: 501C94694E2D04705983F7A709B69CE9
dialogue.line: He's lying.

dialogue.speaker: D3857A9441F680AEF5199BAB78008431
dialogue.line: Heh. I'll try my best.

dialogue.speaker: D52F93F74234B87586759BB74EE4FE81
dialogue.line: I don't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: 7474AE324EBCFE4346445F9D1BF6A9B1
dialogue.line: I have two theories. First, that Layos sold them out to the soldiers. If that’s true, they’re probably dead.

dialogue.speaker: A50720C64DE7F7E93754C8A5EE871BA7
dialogue.line: I saw what his goons did to Mert. Now I'm watching you do the same thing to this man. What makes you any better?

dialogue.speaker: 79CBE69048767DB37F923092760E2A90
dialogue.line: I want you to find those missing scouts.

dialogue.speaker: 137E308444C9CF08D75D3C9FC7256340
dialogue.line: I'd like to ask you one thing, Crake.

dialogue.speaker: 69014B5A43088FC969F7D782A2910379
dialogue.line: I'll be back as soon as possible.

dialogue.speaker: 91B552E74D9950304E6968B273BCDA67
dialogue.line: I'll consider it. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: 1CDFBF5B4A469276BDC907A3FA450CD8
dialogue.line: I'm ready.

dialogue.speaker: 8E36DB7B4375558E2FE5F7B7F68B0AF0
dialogue.line: I'm ready.

dialogue.speaker: 00119A754FB36E1BB9C2F586E69FDD67
dialogue.line: I've just lost four men. More than I can afford.

dialogue.speaker: D589C866428FAAD28A797C8DC0A3CEB7
dialogue.line: I... I don't know... what happened. I don't.

dialogue.speaker: 66CEB0C54C192D1D47240284B90091E7
dialogue.line: If that's what happened, I want to find the deserters... before they start talking.

dialogue.speaker: 39A739DC4AC0A9223427BDB557252DD3
dialogue.line: In the meantime, we'll talk to Layos some more, try to jog his memory.

dialogue.speaker: 5C48544643961B69E6FD1E9A81234444
dialogue.line: Isn't this distrust routine getting a bit old?

dialogue.speaker: 30FB29BB4C637EE46361CB972E6F540B
dialogue.line: Isn't this getting a bit old? The distrust routine?

dialogue.speaker: 166AF694429E65A38AF4A5A9837FE49C
dialogue.line: Layos is – or should I say, was – one of us. He was part of the missing group.

dialogue.speaker: F5B20F2F42B80FFAD324AAA29740D46F
dialogue.line: Moving prisoners under cover of night, paying double for certain supplies.

dialogue.speaker: 21DC4283402EBF68F2D811AA48179947
dialogue.line: My men were supposed to sniff around, figure out what it all meant. They picked up a trail – led them to Neustadt.

dialogue.speaker: 450C21FE46302F2E80732D9CF731F637
dialogue.line: No, no, please...

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: 76A4CCE24E253032508DFB83D63EAE30
dialogue.line: No. Drogos is taking care of that. He'll pay you another visit soon, Layos.

dialogue.speaker: B52945934C23249662C4A8AB6E019052
dialogue.line: No. The guards might be waiting to ambush us there.

dialogue.speaker: EE089DB2415C73985420DFA94830DC1E
dialogue.line: Not all of you want me here.

dialogue.speaker: 34B6D15341AD73B859D2FF88EC0AEA85
dialogue.line: Not everyone can take it. Not for long, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: 3A04BC7749B8EA7B0E710B83A42F34C8
dialogue.line: Now go. We can hold off on Layos... But not for long.

dialogue.speaker: AE48A8694537F014691A82899DA0F9B3
dialogue.line: Oh, and don't get yourself killed, will you?

dialogue.speaker: DC50A140411A926B1472B5820B79BA2F
dialogue.line: Oh, for crying out – I'm here to help!

dialogue.speaker: 364ECCF246CDF7F68542A7855FBE0C0A
dialogue.line: Old, tiresome... yet absolutely necessary.

dialogue.speaker: D8F9F8A847C903A14BCCB6A561B5BF6B
dialogue.line: Patience. We have preparations to make first, and you’ve still got to earn everyone’s trust.

dialogue.speaker: 9F6848424A2BD1DEB234D69C4E6B37B7
dialogue.line: Please.

dialogue.speaker: BDCEE6A94E7C1822A7F4E58A22F23F80
dialogue.line: Postpone Layos’s interrogation until I return. If I find evidence of his guilt, do whatever you think is necessary.

dialogue.speaker: 5D55B4554AD80544FDE6528C29BC4E8C
dialogue.line: Second, that they all deserted, and Layos was the only one stupid enough to let us catch him.

dialogue.speaker: 7FD626904FFC5B845E2485AED6A51B71
dialogue.line: So he went to the tavern and tried asking the soldiers, thinking they 'might know something.'

dialogue.speaker: FA7B00CB423084F736D004AB5E015D8F
dialogue.line: Sure. Drinking blood while you're at it?

dialogue.speaker: BC59B767489A2CED73FA3C82BA4B1BBC
dialogue.line: That's it? Nothing more?

dialogue.speaker: 67FD1E3A4DBFCD2994138988E05E0A97
dialogue.line: That's what I like to hear.

dialogue.speaker: 10E04A0146E7B84EAAF91FA6AB61F417
dialogue.line: That's what I've been trying to find out.

dialogue.speaker: 088C7AAD43B0EF4DDBFE66A677F6F944
dialogue.line: The majority has spoken. As for the rest... You just have to prove them wrong, Coen. And I have just the task for you.

dialogue.speaker: 13F9A42947DAC61156CEFB9479DDA26B
dialogue.line: There's no denying you've proved your worth out there, but loyalty is built through shared hardships and time. In other words – by completing my assignments.

dialogue.speaker: 419D13454C1CDC147EFF0A84E4A6C6BB
dialogue.line: This place can easily be compromised, even by just one person.

dialogue.speaker: 3B1B31A140795D8239AD57AD84B34399
dialogue.line: Ugh, I've proved my worth. You said so yourself.

dialogue.speaker: 12E92BAF4A5D1485553C7A957F4C00D7
dialogue.line: We have reasons to be wary.

dialogue.speaker: 003D22AD489C8A54D41EC5AE45A8391A
dialogue.line: We're constantly looking over our shoulders, second-guessing every word, trusting nobody...

dialogue.speaker: AFB793184A96C91DFE8D879E0D201CD2
dialogue.line: Well. He did, once, too...

dialogue.speaker: 5DCA6E8F433479F879AD4BBEA5892CE8
dialogue.line: Well... Did it work?

dialogue.speaker: AD5847FC4661B35C72ED728642C2C859
dialogue.line: We’ll discuss what to do then...

dialogue.speaker: E57A71D741E7D89CF00E4897F6BA46F6
dialogue.line: What do you think happened?

dialogue.speaker: 52B6300B40B4244FF3B7C2831E34003C
dialogue.line: What happened?

dialogue.speaker: 15BEC8054C26C4DC9C8F319A57593294
dialogue.line: What makes you any better than Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: 668D0B994C34E194010EFAB15D58B711
dialogue.line: What makes you any better than Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: 8CE1A8E1418878B0B143DE8E6AF01BF4
dialogue.line: What was the scouts's exact mission?

dialogue.speaker: BFA4FCB5422026CFD2AF3FAB8D752732
dialogue.line: What was the scouts's mission?

dialogue.speaker: D66BD822400A32C0051F2BB47DF9EEB1
dialogue.line: When do we storm the castle?

dialogue.speaker: EFDC8F9447FCDFC6EB07B49F97F15A0F
dialogue.line: When do we storm the castle?

dialogue.speaker: D110A3CC41558450667248AE02C96948
dialogue.line: When we suspect betrayal, we don’t take half measures.

dialogue.speaker: 52046B8D43C33CEFEB4EB883FA171781
dialogue.line: Where do you want to start?

dialogue.speaker: 02F666D848F15ACF6011B1B0E3387C90
dialogue.line: Who is he?

dialogue.speaker: E42E48AC4511865BDD07AA82BC97A40B
dialogue.line: Who is he?

dialogue.speaker: F44251F84C1BDF788B5881894DEDFC56
dialogue.line: Why did you show him to me, then?

dialogue.speaker: 7744DFC54B54F36CB31657A4C05AE9DE
dialogue.line: Why did you show him to me, then? As a warning? To intimidate me?

dialogue.speaker: 14F5A5F84224C6DB247B559B9F0A2EAA
dialogue.line: Why do you suspect Layos?

dialogue.speaker: 54EF819945778E1A878110AD2649C457
dialogue.line: Why do you suspect Layos?

dialogue.speaker: A1F8024841FA08A1C617B68F9FF1D20B
dialogue.line: Why would they want to desert?

dialogue.speaker: FC13C300449ED351A9FA138E6158EDCC
dialogue.line: Why would they want to desert?

dialogue.speaker: 95AE2B9E4AF6F52AD3DE58A225A95BC5
dialogue.line: Will you wait?

dialogue.speaker: 5F435E3B4A5040D674E1559CD97265CA
dialogue.line: Yes...?

dialogue.speaker: 02FBB8624CEDC5517849DF8AD5D81E3F
dialogue.line: You did this to him?

dialogue.speaker: 749F28B54D01E7E1F2504E9EFA60E413
dialogue.line: You did this to him?

dialogue.speaker: 56AFF790420832D46E3CABB0FC17732D
dialogue.line: You have to admit – not the best line of defence.

dialogue.speaker: 3588A5BE4DC3D0A087740587D26428B7
dialogue.line: You want me to, what, interrogate him?

dialogue.speaker: 1A2963B84796E14CBBE0B68DD3354B75
dialogue.line: You'll understand the temptation soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: FA9E53FB4FC013A6EFEEA49D12DE70A9
dialogue.line: [chuckle] Your words. Not mine.

dialogue.speaker: 88C3F384416975A0D4305B9D75400074
dialogue.line: [scoff] Fat chance...

dialogue.speaker: B5C7C53540CD8DAACAF0FFBC571AB581
dialogue.line: [scoff] How ironic. A vrakhir urging me to act human.

dialogue.speaker: AF5BC10743E4814D37CE5F891E8E883D
dialogue.line: [scoffs] I've got better hair too.

dialogue.speaker: 91F205EA4E6C330A3B404895A7C9BE34
dialogue.line: [sigh] Your candidacy’s a little trickier than most...

dialogue.speaker: 6268FA734568DD34D9A0CEA6295ADA4E
dialogue.line: 'Ancient walls'... 'So close'... There are ruins here? Somewhere beneath the castle? Is that what you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 9E0D6F2A4C1447813B5A9AA63A8ACB50
dialogue.line: Brencis went to the dungeons.

dialogue.speaker: C8F8BB304012D79FAEF1C6A0381C7F11
dialogue.line: But he's still in the castle, right?

dialogue.speaker: 36470A224F7BBCD3B901EF92C5E43400
dialogue.line: But those who fly too close to the sun end up consumed by flames.

dialogue.speaker: 36F7229D48561A181B993AA78E03E094
dialogue.line: Choosing whose blood he is going to use.

dialogue.speaker: 0B0D7E424D33C0511C7B2698D1A1ACE4
dialogue.line: Close. Very close. But this may not be the good news you think it is.

dialogue.speaker: 396459E848D6DB6C7B0FFB934F59D300
dialogue.line: Determination is not enough to cheat your fate, dawnwalker.

dialogue.speaker: EB5AD2A348E9F308EF753DA098211237
dialogue.line: Do you know where my family is?

dialogue.speaker: 4ACC30BC454D59D51DED4DB06E2A5E18
dialogue.line: Gathering the prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: DD4012FD480847BE238B039EF2A770E8
dialogue.line: I commend your courage, Coen. Or your recklessness.

dialogue.speaker: D343E81B421A63D43744B293407BDF33
dialogue.line: I wish you luck, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: D59D515D4ABC4CA52E365E8557D2D019
dialogue.line: I've got to hurry, then.

dialogue.speaker: 3168A0C4467FD7DB4D5F7DBBF261997A
dialogue.line: I've got to hurry.

dialogue.speaker: EC7E4D974CE553E0CE913BA2482A0744
dialogue.line: Ignore it.

dialogue.speaker: F8C4C1F54877774606AB9D838A95D62B
dialogue.line: In the dungeons.

dialogue.speaker: F9647ED849F8F672141337A0334BAE4B
dialogue.line: It doesn't matter. You'll never get there. You're dying in this chamber. I can see that.

dialogue.speaker: 8620504A424CAE13D5D41995C5E98EB7
dialogue.line: No need for words. Death shall soon bring the answers you seek.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: BD2C73FF498A1D9141D4A1B7C32C9B13
dialogue.line: So be it. I shan't stand in your way.

dialogue.speaker: 4E1334334A2D50EEBBA7DBB0048AA415
dialogue.line: So close, and yet – way beyond your reach.

dialogue.speaker: 03BCE6E64975B98B25CD4C95B38EE781
dialogue.line: So close, and yet – way beyond your reach. His chant echoing among the ancient walls.

dialogue.speaker: 9FED65014786337BEEDAABB67F7DE4B8
dialogue.line: So close... Maybe right beneath your feet.

dialogue.speaker: B3FA41FD4C32B812A19121B9E3955255
dialogue.line: So there's a dungeon beneath us.

dialogue.speaker: 53B211C2466F167FB5659AB31AEF3A0C
dialogue.line: Speak plainly, please.

dialogue.speaker: 586823DB4FD838E39542979E2AE596DB
dialogue.line: Speak to me.

dialogue.speaker: D018A0C14218FCC92C302D8CC76C16F7
dialogue.line: Tell me!

dialogue.speaker: 5165CB8545DF3E7C17CD799F83EBE34D
dialogue.line: Thank you, Xanthe.

dialogue.speaker: F98CB1244750759DD583748DAF4A1B74
dialogue.line: Their blood may have been chosen. And if it was, they'll be meeting Brencis soon.

dialogue.speaker: 89DD8F3340EE6B8590EB48AA69D9D212
dialogue.line: They'll be drained, with all the others. Ancient walls – the sole witness of their death.

dialogue.speaker: 3B7647CE40E01A660305FE8A16DF8C92
dialogue.line: They're close. They've been chosen.

dialogue.speaker: BC2A063D42BD8AADA4A3E2AFDD889E18
dialogue.line: They're close... Maybe right beneath your feet.

dialogue.speaker: 709564CF4CDE594C96D30A874F7CA5A6
dialogue.line: To gather the prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: 9CD84AB84B2026AC878348A5C0ADDEF8
dialogue.line: What 'ancient walls'?

dialogue.speaker: 08924DDD45953A2094D7C1B458DAE4E5
dialogue.line: What for?

dialogue.speaker: 68DAC4A847B415F90382A19A47493089
dialogue.line: What for? What is he planning?

dialogue.speaker: 0534BE01480012BD473C2B8060D12679
dialogue.line: What he has always been trying to do. There's no limit to his thirst for power, his greed.

dialogue.speaker: 24ED2B0844E35516276B23AB3E4DAF9A
dialogue.line: What was that sound?

dialogue.speaker: 7879FF5347EC37B0484761BEB3A648DB
dialogue.line: What was that sound?

dialogue.speaker: E172FA1146852E640D3A79A676B4AF91
dialogue.line: What was that sound?

dialogue.speaker: A52643C146B8D02C25DB6F8BDB35AA9B
dialogue.line: Where is Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: 64EF1E9D4B2F22737C9063A9B21A24CC
dialogue.line: Where is my family?! The captives from Laslea!

dialogue.speaker: 20FDAF9D4614D9BB8567D5B55C1624EF
dialogue.line: Where's Brencis?

dialogue.speaker: AA1742D84ED32C5D451E8E8D1FE498B9
dialogue.line: Where's Brencis?!

dialogue.speaker: 78CD598B4A0A67FFBF954D8425C77C19
dialogue.line: Where's my family?

dialogue.speaker: 6F1CBA4C4026E18DB804428B10074834
dialogue.line: You made a mistake coming here. Daytime or not - you will not survive fighting me.

dialogue.speaker: F84359E14DB07720E19A2C8670041AD5
dialogue.line: You made a mistake coming here. One you'll regret severely.

dialogue.speaker: D8FCC08F46761961CBFB47B0B5620FCD
dialogue.line: You're bright. I almost regret having to extinguish you.

dialogue.speaker: 23FE87A74E0349B186FC80ADC682CB19
dialogue.line: Ah, fine. I bow before you! Just let them go.

dialogue.speaker: 5684220C41FDB9BCE63AEA8177BDE7F9
dialogue.line: And I'm the one who killed it, in an abandoned church in the Middens.

dialogue.speaker: C1A280BF4A371805D67EE8B8B65EE109
dialogue.line: And I'm the one who made it happen. I won Crake's favour... and now he's dead because of me.

dialogue.speaker: E9FEF4EC41F34C86055E26A3ED64D88F
dialogue.line: And don't feel bad about what happens next. You did what had to be done to save your kin. That's the mark of a great man.

dialogue.speaker: 6BE5BF3644F72DA190A14FB29D613925
dialogue.line: And how will I know you aren't making this up?

dialogue.speaker: 880DBAE245CEAF6D0A5561B67C2CB06E
dialogue.line: And then... maybe... I will consider your plea.

dialogue.speaker: 23E5023C4B15CCAAAF7FD286D155CA38
dialogue.line: And what about your sire, Isbrand? Lacra found him and took him to an abandoned outpost in the mountains.

dialogue.speaker: A310264049A9BA64B6C3839E40E739ED
dialogue.line: And who knows. Maybe we'll have the pleasure of meeting again, under a different moon.

dialogue.speaker: F74F404B40B6FAB682B5778FB034A0CD
dialogue.line: Believe it or not, I've always valued peace more than war.

dialogue.speaker: 4AC9D4354481CEBA5B90A68AE75858CE
dialogue.line: Bow before me. I want to see you submit.

dialogue.speaker: 2EA0269440F6112290FBB0B412D1B712
dialogue.line: But I don't think you're about to change that.

dialogue.speaker: 22FC32874EF19985FFEB9382ED304368
dialogue.line: But don't concern yourself with that. You'll be dead in a moment.

dialogue.speaker: 248928B146AF1D929E8423BF9A6C61D8
dialogue.line: But don't concern yourself with that. You'll be dead in a moment.

dialogue.speaker: BD680C1448618FA6132E96B8EDFE77C8
dialogue.line: But not these people. I'm sure it makes all the difference to them.

dialogue.speaker: AE2C708A4EBEEB6D40A3CBA51A715FBB
dialogue.line: Do you?

dialogue.speaker: 3607B0D84FA33AFA2913D89CBFEC605D
dialogue.line: Enough. Either you give me something now... or we are done here.

dialogue.speaker: 807B24B040AC2EB16F5F3B9E046A4BBD
dialogue.line: Fine - I'll bow before you.

dialogue.speaker: 9DDC3D3B46262239AA45DBB5DE38928B
dialogue.line: Fine – I'll bow before you.

dialogue.speaker: 0F266AF4497DB11DA9230C833BFFF28C
dialogue.line: First I need to know something. Is it even possible to stop this ritual now? To save them?

dialogue.speaker: 0DC78EB04502E92B5B75E297DC310FAB
dialogue.line: Free my family now.

dialogue.speaker: CBD5E40C49E60BF547A81A9AEE631351
dialogue.line: Free my family now.

dialogue.speaker: 0D15B87A4930D305A13E1992A0B3CA7A
dialogue.line: Free the prisoners now.

dialogue.speaker: 57E5445B4D774BDE520FC084951AA2C9
dialogue.line: Free the prisoners now.

dialogue.speaker: 0830115E4288028CF51662B18727A81E
dialogue.line: Give me something. Something considerable. Compensation for killing my boyars and disrupting the order I established.

dialogue.speaker: 1FF11C70485A1795BC6B1ABCFB655D09
dialogue.line: I almost wish it were true. My world has become much too predictable.

dialogue.speaker: 2F1BA7A544FDE61984B7CC91AC1ABF6B
dialogue.line: I can lead you to your sworn enemy - Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: B2B1037B4A7C9C8FBDCCB19287FF5117
dialogue.line: I can lead you to your sworn enemy - Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 0027DC8049FD3974E335578B9931F270
dialogue.line: I do. All right, then. I accept.

dialogue.speaker: C3EF362C4C20E9D759311A9D5376695B
dialogue.line: I do. All right, then. I accept.

dialogue.speaker: 2A76173E4BBC72A02BDA61893A21A6A4
dialogue.line: I don't know what I could give you.

dialogue.speaker: D40646314D03420FA5A7BB92C3377B8F
dialogue.line: I hoped for something better. There will be no deal.

dialogue.speaker: 44AB25714C44652D782DE9A0542D4F8A
dialogue.line: I just want my family back.

dialogue.speaker: CF89EC9B4CFC7958BF93BBA50B462646
dialogue.line: I just want my family back.

dialogue.speaker: 17A7A5DD437EC6D490BA34A5D144F5A7
dialogue.line: I killed Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 5FE4757246354B054F0C738979C0BF6B
dialogue.line: I killed Lacra.

dialogue.speaker: 40C099294717A3A4987177A191F68F40
dialogue.line: I killed your sworn enemy – Lacra. She meant to attack you.

dialogue.speaker: BB920F3C4664A7B533D864AA27D9978F
dialogue.line: I knew you'd come back to haunt me.

dialogue.speaker: 30C31DEF4A14F91DBCB5E9A9B8B793EF
dialogue.line: I know where the rebels are hiding.

dialogue.speaker: AE53FC1B40C77BB242FF0FBE407C6D14
dialogue.line: I know where the rebels are hiding.

dialogue.speaker: 8AD450F84BEA1EDA92BACAA8C938BE73
dialogue.line: I know where the rebels are hiding. It's the weavers's guild building. Strike at the right time and you'll get Crake himself.

dialogue.speaker: E149679B4FF3A291B6AAB793CB40467E
dialogue.line: I know you're building an army of monsters. I know one of them slaughtered an entire rebel patrol.

dialogue.speaker: 36D8D2CC477FF38E21F4B690ACD10D59
dialogue.line: I may choose to grant you an opportunity to make that happen.

dialogue.speaker: 467499C742752EF6ECABBFAE8821778E
dialogue.line: I met a vrakhir named Lacra. I know she means to kill you.

dialogue.speaker: 4824E8DE4B24E4A7890D43AAFAA0E5B7
dialogue.line: I thought you were dead.

dialogue.speaker: F392C5C64BEA94043C70F18C2630FF71
dialogue.line: I'm even willing to exempt Laslea from my rule. As compensation for... my excessive wrath.

dialogue.speaker: 4A06012A4D7D5207F4C9CB8524E7DAA4
dialogue.line: I'm not bargaining with you.

dialogue.speaker: B28D38B149E282604C6F31A20DEC970A
dialogue.line: I... I don't know what I could give you.

dialogue.speaker: D6B4C7C9442DF23F42CE2CA635ADD108
dialogue.line: Is it even possible to stop this ritual now?

dialogue.speaker: 4207A8E74FA1E9223C07B79B64716C7F
dialogue.line: Is that fucking enough for you?!

dialogue.speaker: 91A2FF394C70333CD0C8B5BCE69F6EB7
dialogue.line: It is. Thank you, my son.

dialogue.speaker: 3E3D5FA4482292BB38C3A491DC41481F
dialogue.line: It's too early for you. Don't even bother to understand.

dialogue.speaker: 992BC1A646B749E891575CB1E16865A0
dialogue.line: It's too early for you. Don't even bother to understand.

dialogue.speaker: DA0B0D21463826391364BABAD8FB7536
dialogue.line: Let's talk about the manumits.

dialogue.speaker: 1AC322724E73F90ACF70BE863D17A20E
dialogue.line: More. Convince me you aren't making this up.

dialogue.speaker: 0D1B80E24AC53AE5D71527A7EAD994DB
dialogue.line: Never mind. Let's get back to Lacra. How will I know you aren't making this up?

dialogue.speaker: CB62CC0C439AB69B3F278798010C9DAD
dialogue.line: Never mind. Let's get back to Lacra. She's no threat to me. You'd need to give me more.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: 0728350F41E74BE9D456B3847E19D969
dialogue.line: No. I won't submit to you.

dialogue.speaker: 86E3BF884238EB1D206119A045036D20
dialogue.line: No. I'm not bargaining with you.

dialogue.speaker: B537089A441126E7EF3342A936FE3B5B
dialogue.line: No. There will be no deal.

dialogue.speaker: C8EA8F9448915D62ABA706B890F5E1AA
dialogue.line: Not so fast. It will require a gift.

dialogue.speaker: 6975D7814FD6E29A5E56A38023D069F4
dialogue.line: Of 'them'? Who are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: 82CCDABE45F7FA263F98AD871E20B501
dialogue.line: Of 'them'? Who are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: C76C3F1B4937ADAAD1DC43999C4A664C
dialogue.line: Oh, for fuck's sake! Let's finish it, then!

dialogue.speaker: 748E582740B138749270FB8882F7BE8D
dialogue.line: Oh? That's... petty. I expected more of them.

dialogue.speaker: 77FBD89A476D1023DB9FF39C26AD04A7
dialogue.line: Oh? That's... petty. I expected more of them.

dialogue.speaker: 5E79AC9C42B0B15C6792409CA26D4D04
dialogue.line: Only if I can't tame it. And I can.

dialogue.speaker: 95535F1A43E82043A6ECAD90209B6CB2
dialogue.line: Only if I can't tame it. And I can.

dialogue.speaker: 61ECF4B24EA2588C1EC6B3B7C4F0AFBA
dialogue.line: Sacrifice - to what end?

dialogue.speaker: 9B405E6B45053415553CFDB07C0B164C
dialogue.line: Sacrifice them... but to what end?

dialogue.speaker: 0E578F874A73981B881CBD9826CCB16A
dialogue.line: So after all this struggle, you have decided to betray your family. To put their lives at risk, needlessly.

dialogue.speaker: 279600E94948A536AB8DD787AF190E58
dialogue.line: So be it.

dialogue.speaker: FB0A6153452271FF4C2DC6BEA12A9740
dialogue.line: So it will make no difference. People will die, no matter what.

dialogue.speaker: 37009D4040B012A2AFC8B6BAB91E6857
dialogue.line: So that's it? You're really letting us go?

dialogue.speaker: 35A2863349751F6D53F4788523266099
dialogue.line: So, what will it be?

dialogue.speaker: 17B32B9C4E9534402EF22280EDA63C1D
dialogue.line: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: FA24F9FF4167722ADB70648E2434B4E4
dialogue.line: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: 0DD80137409D6579B8490EB44CDDD778
dialogue.line: Thanks to me. I won their favour... and then they failed because of me.

dialogue.speaker: E84A4FBF4D26114BD6FA88B801CEA8CC
dialogue.line: That is enough. You can go there and find out for yourself.

dialogue.speaker: F7B9039540462B83B106E0AACC25A9AA
dialogue.line: That must suffice.

dialogue.speaker: 9ED39BB648843CA0A37AE8BF890F071E
dialogue.line: The rebels failed because of me.

dialogue.speaker: F8F5D0B84B8BD99D991305A515523DB2
dialogue.line: The rebels failed because of me.

dialogue.speaker: 1FB137FB4532A94114F38596C7D4EF10
dialogue.line: Then let's see how far your determination goes.

dialogue.speaker: 231BA9E44A4255F96B92549AF88E0F56
dialogue.line: They aren't a problem anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 146C38EE43565E06E72E779F18010000
dialogue.line: They bowed before me – and so must you.

dialogue.speaker: 69EC2BBE44E6CC4AFE02EC8F5FF47406
dialogue.line: This is enough.

dialogue.speaker: 54F765B2499C3A5331CA338CA4CA9FAF
dialogue.line: This must suffice.

dialogue.speaker: 1DCF4D284AAA8A5B276406AD9F0A6754
dialogue.line: This sphere - what the hell is it?

dialogue.speaker: 91BE252B4F3B9C7A319E10ADB4180BFE
dialogue.line: This sphere – what the hell is it?! What are you trying to do?!

dialogue.speaker: 85A1984746B58E98FABE0788C4AE45D6
dialogue.line: Victories went to your head, I see. But make no mistake – I am not them. I am more.

dialogue.speaker: AF3E91F545653F50B2980E91A921613F
dialogue.line: Want to tell that to your boyars?

dialogue.speaker: 761D158340EB90BA997EDCB8CA241DC8
dialogue.line: We'll see about that.

dialogue.speaker: 6F2716314AB223C6D83C6583405D6CF9
dialogue.line: We'll see about that. I may yet surprise you.

dialogue.speaker: A640C072494E9C273805C2B413594481
dialogue.line: Well, here I am.

dialogue.speaker: 10C276C04425A42A737BA68BB0CF48D9
dialogue.line: Well... that's something. All right, then. I accept.

dialogue.speaker: 0DC0FE1E4C2A3C38F01B97B899847E52
dialogue.line: What are you talking about?!

dialogue.speaker: A6D3D40D4E685DEA09EBB2B29E8C755D
dialogue.line: Will you let them go then?

dialogue.speaker: F6FD474042B7F7A9A78631BDB6C5FA90
dialogue.line: With pleasure.

dialogue.speaker: DA4BD892406DEDD2FA336FBE3592AF2B
dialogue.line: Yes!

dialogue.speaker: C1839692446D7803208C9583425B5C19
dialogue.line: Yes. I will need other people to sacrifice, but I will find them. Vale Sangora is a place of abundance.

dialogue.speaker: C070CE8C4FBEECD654EF1084C0EB4225
dialogue.line: You earned it. You are free to go wherever you want.

dialogue.speaker: 9A81110345E409DCF14EC39420632BE1
dialogue.line: You fail to acknowledge the gift I'm giving you. Again. But so be it.

dialogue.speaker: 0BB101A3457B8678A25B5EAA253845B5
dialogue.line: You're about to bring something terrible upon us, aren't you?

dialogue.speaker: A94FCFA64126DF2430F8FB842C82CD3C
dialogue.line: You're about to bring something terrible upon us, aren't you?

dialogue.speaker: 215018C54C00107A8676DE900ADA68D1
dialogue.line: You, of all people, should know what I'm capable of.

dialogue.speaker: 47EDB2A24DCAF3AA4F72698BA0EDB1C1
dialogue.line: You, of all people, should know what I'm capable of.

dialogue.speaker: 9AB200954E41C7EA91723489A7275D75
dialogue.line: Your determination is... commendable. But it can only take you so far.

dialogue.speaker: D43C3A87430879DC89778184F20C1856
dialogue.line: [scoff] Will you let them go if I do?

dialogue.speaker: 2A95FCB1424CA8F920CD27899D756CD9
dialogue.line: Ah, you probably still have much to do. It's alright, go. You can't spend all day listening to an old woman's prattle...

dialogue.speaker: 114A2B7846B56C899C943C978E8ADFAA
dialogue.line: Always carrying the weight of the world, aren't you, Coen? Trying to do your best by everyone.

dialogue.speaker: 797298424651872C192DED9406468A58
dialogue.line: Amen.

dialogue.speaker: 7D13E4B346A7A65864635F9870C14735
dialogue.line: Amen.

dialogue.speaker: 0138EF644456A6E0C74DD59C7FC35FEA
dialogue.line: And to lose your whole family... I'm so sorry, my boy.

dialogue.speaker: C4CE92B2455AB50D1B76C18B335388B4
dialogue.line: Anything I can do for you?

dialogue.speaker: C6A14AAF413256546920A8A9E8E43EB2
dialogue.line: Anything I can do for you?

dialogue.speaker: EA1970DE4DDC0A167F9BE782F5AD1A57
dialogue.line: At least now she's with poor Esme. And with my Kvet.

dialogue.speaker: 21E853A040DF670F193D52A5037BA06B
dialogue.line: At least the rest of your family is together again.

dialogue.speaker: B86629F54C8130CE0F0794BCE6CB51D0
dialogue.line: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. May they rest in peace. Amen.

dialogue.speaker: 31A86AAD429D3F307BEC62ACB6E37410
dialogue.line: Go. The cemetery – it's not a good place for you right now.

dialogue.speaker: 658E83DA44AFC3D8A8FE9BB2FC36A292
dialogue.line: I know the feeling very well. We're kin, in that pain.

dialogue.speaker: 40A6088A4B177ACEB11EF5860491ED37
dialogue.line: I spent all my waking hours trying to save everyone... Fat lot of good that did.

dialogue.speaker: EDC030C847364B07989B8B852A3B4BF4
dialogue.line: I still can't believe it.

dialogue.speaker: CB4FD7F84B686DE6F7FE78B05E087617
dialogue.line: I worry about you, child. This world is not fair for those who have goodness in their hearts.

dialogue.speaker: 70E7EB204FA7A10BEA938AB295DDB456
dialogue.line: I'll be fine. I'm like a cat, I always land on my feet.

dialogue.speaker: 933BA88D418A18D3693962BF64AE5ABD
dialogue.line: I'll check it out. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: 5D138D2848CBA76F455BE1B8260ECF2A
dialogue.line: I'll stay here for a while longer. Keep the little ones company.

dialogue.speaker: 9494E139471A6C929D35A5915FD06E02
dialogue.line: It doesn't seem real. It's – it's like a nightmare I can't wake up from.

dialogue.speaker: C1B2CD16443EAE2FBD0D59B14BB62575
dialogue.line: It's a true miracle that you were able to kill the knyaz. It's as if God's angels drove your sword.

dialogue.speaker: A84FF98947CBAA01A8A2BBA9570B094D
dialogue.line: It's all my fault.

dialogue.speaker: D1BDFA8A4B3589E60EBF7C9F64570328
dialogue.line: It's all my fault. If only I'd acted sooner, Brencis wouldn't –

dialogue.speaker: 4032B22246C1B4985E4EBD88AF9AFC66
dialogue.line: It's for the best. That woman has been through so much pain already...

dialogue.speaker: 119A3B3840103891C8645A8E589E9993
dialogue.line: It's the only thing that does.

dialogue.speaker: AD48832E42FB8A661E3BF8B3E3510FE4
dialogue.line: It's the only thing that does.

dialogue.speaker: 538DC5474182481FA8D6B3916016051A
dialogue.line: Life [scoff] - what's it for? What's the point, in a cruel world like this?

dialogue.speaker: 67B9B8A6471DADB2B86962B01270620B
dialogue.line: Maybe...

dialogue.speaker: 545F73414B0AE5D4CB023F8A67F40256
dialogue.line: No, no. You coming here to mourn the dead with me today - that's enough.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: 8BD8913A4CDF494DF40971A54768518A
dialogue.line: Oh, Coen. Such misery... To lose someone so young...

dialogue.speaker: 21AC89CD441A60EE404A81B0EAE4557D
dialogue.line: Oh, Coen... It pains me to see so much hurt in someone so young.

dialogue.speaker: F3757A754A6E2A67DA05868F2E6BC489
dialogue.line: Oh, good thinking, better prepare for the winter. Hmm... Rainer, maybe? Think I saw one at his stall, down in the village square.

dialogue.speaker: 4C68825C4E2352D41D189DBFBDF828A4
dialogue.line: Right, I should get going.

dialogue.speaker: 2B9380914E0D985992482BBEF9620C53
dialogue.line: Right, I've got errands to run. Speaking of which, any idea who might have a spare blanket for sale?

dialogue.speaker: 1AB0FC4D4B685854E8A04CB17319552F
dialogue.line: Sometimes it makes no sense, does it? Death...

dialogue.speaker: BE3A107A4C8114FDE068C88BA79A6062
dialogue.line: Thank you, Crina.

dialogue.speaker: CB3D47F84195635801FD26A937C52929
dialogue.line: Thank you, Crina.

dialogue.speaker: DA54477A4A265A3FD7924383A95F4787
dialogue.line: The difference is, I won't be bearing it much longer now...

dialogue.speaker: 92EC5C99463EC32EC4F500AC70A2C726
dialogue.line: Wasn't quick enough though...

dialogue.speaker: 7B06809E4FB4030F1C4DD18821ABF5FE
dialogue.line: Whatever do you mean?

dialogue.speaker: 46D9688E4155C7546DD3559E47723DF0
dialogue.line: When God took my grandson... I couldn't understand it. I looked for an answer, but none came to me...

dialogue.speaker: A1304D174E25E507D4D6CBB57C265331
dialogue.line: You even returned Kvet's pendant, just so an old woman could stop bawling her eyes out.

dialogue.speaker: 12D71D504A8C61BC8D72EAA55E5BA7C8
dialogue.line: Your mother... you didn't tell her, did you?

dialogue.speaker: 4495F54E49B69722C5EA649A9FBF5B3A
dialogue.line: [say nothing]

dialogue.speaker: A8931EE94822B5931DBE4098E548B554
dialogue.line: You're worried.

dialogue.speaker: 6CEB591D42FD8FD604BC97B9B66C35B9
dialogue.line: All you can do is pick at the scabs.

dialogue.speaker: 6A7708EF4E7757E4C4E026A0A5102AD9
dialogue.line: And I believe you. There's not much you can't do when you set your mind to it.

dialogue.speaker: A7C94F99412DA0AF218455A0DE40A159
dialogue.line: Aye. And sometimes it starts festering and you die.

dialogue.speaker: 0C2C38124F1E3956BEF4AEB8A00FB372
dialogue.line: Brencis... changed me forever. And even now... he still haunts me.

dialogue.speaker: 9C21A0ED468FFFCA0C6568B1FA4356BB
dialogue.line: But no. You keep pushing me away. Why?

dialogue.speaker: B0C3A14F449C53A4066433921159FAB5
dialogue.line: Dad? I see you're worried.

dialogue.speaker: E2147FA14C921C4C55F623A238476370
dialogue.line: Different! A monster! Just accept it!

dialogue.speaker: 927353D74DDFF401C7E41D9E205C99AB
dialogue.line: Don't you scoff at me.

dialogue.speaker: C591DEDD4A25DB927343A1A2E96E4D21
dialogue.line: Everything's alright.

dialogue.speaker: B4DBDBC5415AEF134B8F07B46F037751
dialogue.line: Have, I though?

dialogue.speaker: E8A3A5F04BC6BA6CFAEE64B8BCB4896A
dialogue.line: Hm? Have you?

dialogue.speaker: 63C971AF493A1680A212DA809ED0D996
dialogue.line: I did exactly what he wanted. Those people... and even then, he... Oh, God.

dialogue.speaker: FDB2DD984155FA82DD9F209C4463ADA1
dialogue.line: I said it's fine.

dialogue.speaker: 272AE6774E23E3A49F4E9493E1CD060C
dialogue.line: I said it's fine. You should focus on getting ready for winter.

dialogue.speaker: 1F0E348646666B1EA68900AC8F6C911E
dialogue.line: I swear I'll never make that mistake again.

dialogue.speaker: 16662FE7475CC4320FA94BA5E3E728C6
dialogue.line: I think we're done here. You can go... Deal with...

dialogue.speaker: F4B9FB4942F72213A6FDA4A64C9AEBF4
dialogue.line: I thought that after all this – that maybe, just maybe, you'd start talking to me.

dialogue.speaker: 6D023CDB4EB49D4F0848769DD276222D
dialogue.line: I'll make it right. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: 08C4CF9A45FD2111006A78BAF9EF82C0
dialogue.line: I'm here, dad.

dialogue.speaker: 773EC9F24713F05CA06169B6F53C1629
dialogue.line: I'm not your child. Not anymore.

dialogue.speaker: 8936D0CE42A137B87DEBB78061B54BE8
dialogue.line: I'm not your child. Not anymore.

dialogue.speaker: A3BBB3CF4185BD862752C986BF3F276B
dialogue.line: I've learned to walk with my limp, son. It's painful and slow, but I manage.

dialogue.speaker: 54684AD149637A293E71FFA8109C928D
dialogue.line: I-I don't have time for this nonsense. You are–

dialogue.speaker: 576DC4BC433C0DE72AABADA01B652422
dialogue.line: I... I have to go. Get some things and then stop by at Anca's.

dialogue.speaker: 3916833C4569A963545AB09C0426CA3B
dialogue.line: I... I have to go. Get some things and then stop by at Vesel's.

dialogue.speaker: 2A7DE55C4E9845B106998DA581B8421E
dialogue.line: I... I'll make it right. I have no idea how yet, but I will. I promise you that.

dialogue.speaker: 70B5CAF1470E077F6D09E8B9875524E4
dialogue.line: It's fine, dad.

dialogue.speaker: C0E713E247FB0D2E290354A306D93056
dialogue.line: It's the same shit again!

dialogue.speaker: BA24593F4F9C8D73C29B9F830FC1A0EF
dialogue.line: It's the same shit. All over again!

dialogue.speaker: B5DB87E84D71B72B4A5AC49DA746CCED
dialogue.line: Mhm.

dialogue.speaker: 74E5BA81407D2CA2D5DD6A91B2431708
dialogue.line: Mhm. Need anything else?

dialogue.speaker: 4E6A975F43EE8B63E4FC64942980AB12
dialogue.line: Need anything else?

dialogue.speaker: E779F3E4481F1BF5C11CFE98E43446DC
dialogue.line: No, not really.

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: 23F45BF848FED826613024BA7A3AE3E5
dialogue.line: Oh, dad.

dialogue.speaker: 54153AAF4B614F7BEFD62EAD728C7129
dialogue.line: Quite the man you've grown up to be.

dialogue.speaker: BCCAF6AF496745146A72CF8F59C49F1E
dialogue.line: Remember when Kazmir broke his leg? And then he had a limp, winced with each step?

dialogue.speaker: 9044A451451C4244B681A5A72643D528
dialogue.line: Right. Some things - they're just too painful to talk about.

dialogue.speaker: BB3436824199E5D0E3AEF5B2300BE44E
dialogue.line: Right. Some things - they're too painful to talk about.

dialogue.speaker: 94C3429946E13AC9CC34FCBFBADA4EDD
dialogue.line: Right. Sorry, it's just –

dialogue.speaker: 1DC4DD1B4C83EF6F4F1FA29729967C92
dialogue.line: Right. Sorry.

dialogue.speaker: D18F397E48F815E23E25C5AE9989CED3
dialogue.line: Some things – they just don't mend, son. Ever.

dialogue.speaker: 59CABBC141399A5C3D4CB38BF1DB5E21
dialogue.line: Sometimes that's what you need to do for the wound to fully heal.

dialogue.speaker: 8EFF8D684BAA6CCA7FDDA2B123330512
dialogue.line: Stay safe, my son.

dialogue.speaker: A89213C8452A71809E12509FAAA0B3EA
dialogue.line: Stay safe... Coen.

dialogue.speaker: B55041AD4DA256E2A8AA92A07E1BF8DF
dialogue.line: Sure, I'll do that.

dialogue.speaker: 030A5E054A42E4A4B16B04BF37ED4694
dialogue.line: Sure. Let's do it.

dialogue.speaker: 4E19F34D4C734D949633E6A1F9940948
dialogue.line: That night, in Laslea... I was sure Brencis was going to rip you to shreds. Guess we both underestimated you.

dialogue.speaker: 69AFDDD64860D68B6A471CB605C7EE1D
dialogue.line: That will do it. At least now we won't freeze when winter comes.

dialogue.speaker: 3DC4177A4C4EF05CA6C8E3B524C11463
dialogue.line: That's what you need to do to cleanse the wound.

dialogue.speaker: D72385C9460AE9D40D07FC87FB6AF0A4
dialogue.line: Took you long enough. Alright, let's put in the door. You ready?

dialogue.speaker: 08228F8448D014FBD030418D40C3C819
dialogue.line: What are you...? For God's sake, of course you're my child!

dialogue.speaker: 89EE93E44FB89CBE0B472FB80895856F
dialogue.line: Would a son of yours grow claws when dusk falls? Drink human blood?

dialogue.speaker: E540BD8B4A84BF8C8FAB5D9661D3E83A
dialogue.line: Yeah! That's my point. You don't let me in on anything that's going on in that head of yours!

dialogue.speaker: 1CB1324649537EF51C57A68D212A62E7
dialogue.line: Yeah. Anca said his bone grew back crooked.

dialogue.speaker: 78917C4A47EF579C9AAD8DBCD99B39E5
dialogue.line: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 99F85759461DA531F790FA8550728D36
dialogue.line: Yes. Yes I have.

dialogue.speaker: 8DB3121A4534ED6396F68DBB1ED080FC
dialogue.line: You can leave me behind now, follow your own path. It's alright.

dialogue.speaker: 7A00577E4F791D0E9B394995DA12030F
dialogue.line: You don't understand.

dialogue.speaker: 068679AC41CA40801EF082BC5B2E1F4E
dialogue.line: You saved us, Coen.

dialogue.speaker: 075595BF4C9CB7C5033BEAAAF0A9A4AF
dialogue.line: You shouldn't have to. No child of mine should.

dialogue.speaker: 84511A1949C537402DBE608B8E560399
dialogue.line: [scoff]

dialogue.speaker: 7D3DF050454DAA3628C58C952F6D595C
dialogue.line: Do you know how to use a sword?

dialogue.speaker: 669DDEAD48EB624712A003BE7C307D43
dialogue.line: Hey, it's my turn to ask him! So, um... Are you looking for an apprentice?

dialogue.speaker: uriash_soldier_male08
dialogue.line: No.

dialogue.speaker: 7F23A87047F3C3BB01F95FA84B0924C0
dialogue.line: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: F3073359471979F1AC8F7784581E503B
dialogue.line: Oh, oh! Have you –

dialogue.speaker: EDB875AE44335186914C438C7B600E7D
dialogue.line: Really?!

dialogue.speaker: 5574113B48CC5964A40247A950D56596
dialogue.line: Um... have you been to Svartrau?

dialogue.speaker: 2BB7D00B4527A4D9178AE6936B8EADC4
dialogue.line: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: 83BDF6804DD955D4D7EC28B5A7A9CACC
dialogue.line: Yes.
